You will define how always-on perceiving devices respect the physical space and the people in it, and you will turn that into shipped customer experiences, from today's early real-time visual features to a broad ambient transparency and control surface across the device fleet. You will work across product, engineering, science, design, hardware, legal, and privacy to make trust a reason customers choose our devices.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Ambient Trust across perceiving surfaces (including voice, vision, and ambient sensing).
- Define the customer experience for ambient transparency and control
- Advance real-time visual understanding experiences from early release toward dependable activation, accuracy, broader device coverage, and proactive, opt-in capabilities.
- Write the narratives and requirements that align leadership and partner teams, and represent Ambient Trust in cross-organization reviews with Product, Hardware, Engineering, Legal, Responsible AI, and Privacy.
- Define the metrics that prove ambient experiences are both trusted and useful, and use them to prioritize.

A day in the life

No two days look the same in this role. You will move between setting long-term product direction and making the concrete calls that keep experiences moving, partnering closely with engineering, science, design, and other teams to turn a hard trust problem into something customers actually feel. You will spend time listening to customers and translating what you learn into priorities, aligning leaders and partner teams behind a clear plan, and making the judgment calls that balance capability, usefulness, and trust. The common thread is that you are the person making sure that as our devices become more capable, customers feel more in control, not less.

title: Program Manager, AWS Marketing, AWS Launch Operations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) brings new services and features to customers at an unprecedented cadence — more than 3,000 launches a year, and accelerating as the AI landscape evolves. Behind that velocity is the Launch Operations team, which owns the process that governs the lifecycle of bringing every AWS capability to customers, from intake through customer availability. We turn AWS’s innovation velocity into a durable Marketing advantage: driving operational scale so service teams and stakeholders can focus on innovation, and improving signal-to-noise so the most important news reaches customers and enables field sales and partner teams to engage around the launches that matter most.

We are looking for a Program Manager II to run the programs that make this possible. You will operate at the center of the launch process, coordinating across product managers, marketing, engineering, security, legal, and field teams to keep launches moving on time and at a high quality bar. This is a role for someone who is organized, resourceful, and energized by the challenge of managing high-visibility, cross-functional programs where the details matter and the scale is significant. You will not just track the process — you will improve it, identifying where the sequential handoffs and manual coordination slow launches down, and designing the workflows and tooling that compress that timeline and align launch velocity with engineering velocity.

Key job responsibilities
1. Own the end-to-end launch operations program — defining milestones, tracking deliverables, mitigating risks, and keeping launches on schedule across multiple concurrent workstreams and stakeholder teams.

2. Coordinate across product managers, marketing, engineering, security, legal, pricing, and field teams to align on priorities, remove blockers, and drive launches from intake to customer availability.

3. Identify process gaps in how launches move through the pipeline and implement improvements that raise quality, reduce cycle time, and compress the sequential handoff chains that dominate the launch timeline.

4. Partner with task-owner teams to bring automation directly into their review workflows, improving operational scale so the program can support 3,000+ launches per year.

5. Define and monitor program metrics to measure delivery performance and improve signal-to-noise, then use those insights to inform planning and elevate the most important launches to customers.

6. Apply generative AI tools to streamline processes, status reporting, and program analysis, and help embed these tools into the team’s day-to-day operating model.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing the launch pipeline and flagging any launches at risk of slipping, then work with the relevant task owners to unblock them. Mid-morning, you run a working session with product and marketing partners to align on upcoming Tier 1 launches and lock down next steps. After lunch, you pull together a status update for leadership, summarizing progress, program metrics, and the open decisions that need their input. Between meetings, you are refining the intake process for new launches and looking for ways to remove friction and automate the manual coordination that slows the next cycle down by prototyping that improvement with generative AI tooling before you socialize it with the team.

About the team
The AWS Lifecycle Marketing team shapes how the world’s leading cloud and AI portfolio reaches customers. We orchestrate how AWS launches are integrated with Marketing planning, how lifecycle changes are managed responsibly, and how the portfolio is represented across shared surfaces and priority moments — removing complexity, increasing visibility, and ensuring Marketing can act with the coordination, speed, and strategic focus the portfolio requires. Launch Operations is the connective tissue between AWS Service Engineering and AWS Marketing, and this role sits at the heart of a multi-year transformation from manual, relationship-driven coordination to scalable, data-driven platforms. If you want to work on programs that shape how millions of customers experience AWS innovation, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams

title: Tech Lead Testing, RIVR
descriptionHtml:
RIVR, an Amazon company, is building Physical AI by deploying autonomous robots for real-world doorstep delivery. Operating daily in diverse urban environments, RIVR's robots continuously learn from and navigate the millions of scenarios encountered during deliveries. By owning the full stack from software to hardware, RIVR is purpose-built for safety, reliability, and the customer from day one.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will still design test benches, write automation code, and dig into data, but you will also mentor engineers, drive process maturity, and represent testing in cross-functional planning. If you combine deep technical expertise in hardware testing with the ability to set priorities, grow people, and influence design outcomes, this role offers a unique opportunity to shape how a Physical AI company validates its products.

Key job responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Strategy
Define and own the end-to-end test strategy for structural, mechatronic, and sensing subsystems, aligned with product development milestones.

Establish testing standards, processes, and best practices across the team, including test plan templates, data management workflows, and reporting formats.

Make architectural decisions on test infrastructure: investments into instrumentation platforms, automation frameworks, and data pipelines.

Drive continuous improvement of test coverage, efficiency, and predictive capability.

Hands-On Testing & Engineering
Design, commission, and operate test benches for mechatronics systems (actuators, mechanism, cabling and sensor), including fixture design, instrumentation layout, and safety concepts.

Select, integrate, and calibrate sensors, load cells, thermocouples with a thorough understanding of their working principles and error influences.

Develop and maintain automation scripts (Python, Labview) to control test hardware, execute stress and performance tests, and log critical data.

Process and analyze test data applying signal processing and statistics fundamental to extract meaningful performance metrics.

Reporting & Design Influence
Compile clear, structured test reports that compare results against specifications, highlight anomalies, and derive actionable engineering learnings to feed back into the design cycle.

Identify failure modes, performance bottlenecks, and reliability risks, translating findings into concrete design recommendations.

Represent the test function in design reviews, providing data-driven input on FMEA, and qualification criteria.

Team & Collaboration
Mentor and grow test engineers, fostering technical depth and a culture of rigorous, curiosity-driven experimentation.

Collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, firmware, and systems engineers to align test strategies with product requirements.

Coordinate with external test labs and suppliers when specialized testing is required.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of experience in hardware testing or validation, with at least 3 years in a technical leadership or senior individual contributor role.
- Proven experience designing and commissioning test benches for electro-mechanical system or consumer electronics with significant power and motion elements.
- Strong scripting proficiency in Python for test automation, device control, and data analysis.
- Practical knowledge of sensors and instrumentation — torque cells, encoders, load cells, thermocouples, strain gauges, including their working principles, error influences, and calibration requirements.
- Demonstrated ability to turn test data into clear engineering insights that influence design decisions.
- Experience developing and reviewing test plans, test cases, and qualification criteria.
- The ability to work hands-on in a workshop environment and use common tools safely.
- Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related technical field.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with motor or actuator characterization (efficiency mapping, cogging-torque analysis, thermal correlation).
- Familiarity with test automation frameworks (LabVIEW, pytest) or hardware-in-the-loop setups.
- Understanding of measurement uncertainty analysis (GUM) and calibration procedures.
- Hands-on experience with ROS/ROS2.
- Experience with CAD software (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar) for designing test fixtures.
- Knowledge of data acquisition (DAQ) hardware and system integration.

title: Amazon Key – B2B Growth marketer, Amazon Key
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Key is building an infrastructure-agnostic access layer for the housing sector that overlays intelligent keyless access onto existing electrical systems for communal entrance without replacing what is already installed. For contractors and staff who work across multiple buildings and portfolios, it replaces fragmented keys, codes and sign-in processes with a single seamless UX on their phone. For property teams, it creates a centralized process, with tamper-proof audit trails that becomes the one system of record for every non-resident entry, every day. For delivery drivers, it grants secure, time-bound access to communal entrances so parcels arrive safely inside the building instead of being left exposed or bounced back as failed deliveries; no keys, fobs or resident buzz-in required. We have a proven product and now we need an engine: a repeatable, instrumented, signal-driven machine that finds the right accounts, reaches the right decision-makers with the right message at the right moment, and hands Sales a warm, qualified, prioritized queue every single day.
We are looking for a B2B Growth marketer to design, build, and own that engine. This is a founding, high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations. You will treat go-to-market like software: define the signals that indicate a housing provider is ready to buy, build the enrichment and outbound workflows that act on those signals, wire them into the CRM, measure conversion at every stage.
You will be the technical architect of lead generation, outbound, and signal detection for Amazon Key across the.
This role is highly cross-functional.


Key job responsibilities
• Design the signal layer. Define and codify the buying signals that indicate an housing provider is in-market. Build the pipelines that detect them continuously.
• Build the lead-gen engine end-to-end. Own sourcing → enrichment → scoring → routing → sequencing → attribution as a versioned, monitored system. Turn target-account lists into instrumented outbound programs.
• Automate enrichment and data quality: Build data extraction and scraping flows from scratch. Stand up custom web-scraping and data-extraction pipelines where no clean source exists, feeding them into enrichment so target lists are built, not bought.
• Generate account-specific outreach at scale. Build AI-assisted systems that produce personalized, on-message outreach for named accounts and multi-channel cadences with strong deliverability hygiene.
• Instrument and report conversion. Define the funnel metrics (reply rate, meeting rate, pilot rate, stage conversion, time-to-money) and build the dashboards that feed conversion heartbeat.
• Integrate the GTM stack.
• Run experiments like an engineer. Ship, measure, iterate, and deprecate.
• Read the commercial picture, not just the tech. You understand how a housing deal actually gets won, where demand comes from, how a prospect moves from first touch to signature, and which numbers predict revenue. That lets you decide what to build and what to drop based on impact on the funnel, so the engine is judged by deals closed, not workflows shipped.
• Run your own show end to end. Give you a problem and a goal, not a spec, and you'll scope it, build a first version, put it in front of users, and keep refining until it holds up in production. You chase down what's broken yourself, close your own knowledge gaps, and carry a problem all the way to a working result rather than handing it off half-solved.


A day in the life
The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Telecommunication Sector. The position is classified at level 7 or above, depending on the candidate's skills, competences and experience.

About the team
The Amazon Key team sits within the Amazon Devices team alongside Ring and other Home Security teams. Key is a uniquely cross-functional team within Amazon, and often serves as the connective tissue between Smart Home/Devices, Logistics, Operations, and Retail/Shopping. We are the bridge between device management and physical services, and our team indexes highly on ownership and collaboration. We have lots of stakeholders, and we have relentlessly high standards for our high-visibility programs.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in in a GTM Engineering, Revenue Operations, Growth Engineering, Marketing Operations, or Sales Engineering role with hands-on system-building ownership.
- Demonstrated experience building automated lead-generation or outbound systems end-to-end (sourcing, enrichment, scoring, routing, sequencing, attribution).
- Lead generation and enrichment: proven experience sourcing target accounts and contacts (including custom data extraction and web scraping) and enriching them with firmographic, technographic, and intent data to produce sales-ready, prioritized pipeline.
- CRM integration and funnel management: proven experience integrating automated flows and data inputs into a CRM and managing the commercial funnel end-to-end, including lifecycle stages, handoffs, and reporting reliable enough to forecast from.
- Expert-level CRM proficiency (Salesforce or HubSpot) at an administrator level, including objects, workflows, lifecycle logic, and reporting.
- Hands-on experience with GTM automation and enrichment tooling (e.g., Clay, n8n/workflow automation, enrichment and intent-data APIs) and with multi-channel outbound (email + LinkedIn) including deliverability best practices.
- Working proficiency with SQL and with integrating tools via APIs.
- Proven ability to define metrics and build dashboards that measure funnel conversion and pipeline impact.
- Strong written and verbal communication in English.

peut inclure, mais ne sont pas limités à :

title: Program Manager I, GCOI
descriptionHtml:
Grocery Catalog Operations and Intel (GCOI) is responsible for catalog operations across Amazon Fresh, Whole Foods Market, Quick commerce and Grocery Partnerships businesses. The team ensures product catalog accuracy, completeness, and compliance across online and in-store grocery platforms, directly impacting customer experience, search relevance, and supply chain efficiency. GCOI manages over 100+ operational workstreams spanning new item setup, catalog defect resolution, attribute validation, and merchant onboarding support.

We are looking for a Program Manager to own catalog defect resolution and readiness execution for Whole Foods Market within the Grocery Catalog Operations and Intel (GCOI) team.

This role is the bridge between the specialists who execute catalog operations and the program and product managers who own the systems behind them. Specialists escalate to you when the SOP runs out. Program and product owners come to you when they need to know what is actually happening in the catalog. You will drive ASIN-level defects to root cause, quantify blast radius, document what you find, and carry recurring failures to the teams that own the fix.

If you like dive-deep problem solving, want to build program management depth in a business where catalog quality is the constraint, and want to be the person holding the real answer, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
Bridge catalog execution and program ownership: Own the escalation path for ASIN-level catalog defects that exceed existing procedures, driving each to root cause or a confirmed accountable owner
Absorb volume during spikes and coverage gaps rather than only routing it, so the team's SLA position holds when inflow exceeds plan
Convert operational symptoms into problem statements that program managers, product managers, and engineering partners can act on
Speak for GCOI in defect triage forums and cross-team working sessions, supplying the operational evidence no partner team can see from their side
Land partner and product decisions back with the specialist team in executable form: what changed, what the new handling is, what to do differently from the next ticket onward
Own the documentation trail for every defect you drive (investigation path, root cause, resolution, prevention) and author or refresh SOPs so the next occurrence is resolvable without escalation
Execute assigned catalog readiness tasks, from ASIN creation through attribute validation, against defined workback schedules
Mentor Catalog specialist and Automation Leads on troubleshooting methodology and catalog tooling, raising what the team resolves without escalation

About the team
GCOI team drives operational excellence through continuous innovation and defect elimination, delivering seamless and reliable experiences for customers and stakeholders. Our commitment centers on maximizing resource efficiency while eliminating operational waste, leveraging data-driven metrics to enhance performance, and providing strategic support across Catalog programs. Through our BI capabilities, we deliver actionable insights that power informed decision-making across US Grocery operations.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in MS Access and SQL
- Experience working in an analytical environment with cross-functional teams
- Knowledge of general AI tools

title: Bus Dev Manager - Amazon Leo , Amazon Leo B2B, Amazon Leo B2B
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable broadband connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From households to small businesses, schools, hospitals, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve communities and organizations operating in places without dependable internet access.

Lead regional go-to-market strategy and execution for Amazon Leo across Asia-Pacific and Japan. You'll own the regional business plan - identifying which industries and customer segments to pursue, adapting proven sales approaches for local markets, and building pipeline through direct engagement and strategic partnerships. You'll work with customers to connect next-generation low-latency connectivity to real business outcomes, invent new approaches where the region demands it, and feed market intelligence back into the global organization to sharpen the worldwide strategy. This role operates at the intersection of emerging technology, complex enterprise sales, and international market development.

This position may require access to information, technology, or hardware that is subject to export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Employment in this position is contingent upon obtaining any required export licenses or other approvals from the United States government. As such, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain any necessary export licenses or approvals based on their nationality, citizenship, and any other factors considered by the applicable export control regulations.

Key job responsibilities
Own the regional go-to-market strategy for Amazon Leo across Asia-Pacific and Japan, identifying which industries, customer segments, and use cases to pursue based on local market dynamics, regulatory environment, coverage footprint, and competitive landscape

Take proven industry sales approaches developed by global teams and adapt them for APJ markets, localizing positioning, adjusting for regional channel structures, navigating local regulatory requirements, and tailoring deal approaches to how enterprises in the region buy

Originate and develop enterprise opportunities with major accounts across the region, shaping commercial terms and working through procurement, regulatory, and integration complexity to advance deals from first conversation to qualified pipeline

Enable local sales teams to position Leo effectively within their accounts by running structured training sessions, joining customer engagements where needed, and building the repeatable tools and materials that let sellers open conversations on business outcomes rather than technology specifications

Identify use cases and market opportunities unique to APJ that global playbooks don't yet address, prove them with reference customers, and package them so they can be replicated across the region and fed back to the global organization

Serve as the voice of APJ within the worldwide business development organization, surfacing market intelligence, competitive encounters, win/loss insights, regulatory shifts, and product gaps backed by customer evidence so the global strategy stays grounded in regional reality


A day in the life
We are a growing business development organization building the enterprise motion for Amazon Leo, a transformative satellite connectivity initiative. Our team operates with significant autonomy and visibility across Amazon, working at the intersection of customer needs, AWS capabilities, and Leo's product roadmap. We're structured around industry verticals globally, with regional leaders who take proven approaches into international markets, adapt them for local conditions, and invent where their region demands it.

Your focus is taking proven industry sales approaches into Asia-Pacific and Japan, building pipeline through regional sellers and partners, and feeding market intelligence back to the global team. You'll work with global industry leads to agree which approaches to bring into APJ each quarter, then adapt them for local regulatory, procurement, and competitive realities. You'll prioritize which industry segments matter most in the region and invent new approaches where APJ markets present opportunities that global playbooks don't yet cover. You'll build the capability of local sales teams so they can position Leo on business outcomes rather than connectivity specifications, and own strategic customer engagements where no established playbook yet exists.

On any given day, you might join a seller on a discovery call with a CIO exploring network resilience, map how connectivity gaps create cost across a manufacturer's value chain to build the business case for a Leo-based solution, adapt a global energy sector sales approach for an APJ market, or run a training session for local sellers. You'll also serve as the voice of the region, surfacing competitive encounters, regulatory shifts, and product gaps backed by customer evidence so the global strategy stays grounded in what's happening on the ground.

About the team

title: Regional Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role:
As the Regional Automation Engineer, you will engage on all aspects of high-level support for the control systems within a region of Amazon sites. This work takes the form of direct field engagement for launch and existing facilities, commissioning, on-call, continuous improvement, change management, project management, training, security, infrastructure and systems administration. You will deliver this through the use of statistics and data analytics, structured problem solving, implementation of global support mechanisms, system performance monitoring tools, identification and dissemination of best practices. In this role, you will also develop and implement standard operating procedures, optimal code/parameter sets, performance metrics, and feedback mechanisms to ensure reliability and operational efficiency of our equipment.

What Do We Offer?
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. - 4+ years of Siemens, Allen-Bradley or Codesys Ladder Logic and structure programming experience
- 4+ years of robotics work cells and control systems experience
- 4+ years of electrical theory, robotics, controls components, and automated equipment experience

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent
- Master's degree, or Six Sigma Black Belt certification
- Experience leading controls in manufacturing or complex industrial environments
- Experience identifying, maintaining, troubleshooting, and modifying Motor Controls including motor starters, Variable Frequency Drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components

title: Applied Scientist, AGI/AI Security
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an Applied Scientist to contribute to research and development of novel security validation and monitoring techniques for AI systems at scale. You will own and contribute to four critical work-streams:

1. Real-Time Agent Monitoring
Design and implement scientific approaches for continuous behavioral analysis of AI agents in production—detecting anomalous actions, prompt injection exploitation, and policy violations in real time.

2. Protection & Automated Remediation
Invent and deliver novel protection technologies and automated remediation techniques building on research in security, cryptography, privacy, automated reasoning, and others domains, to enable safe and secure agentic AI models and AI applications.

3. AI Application and Capabilities Validation
Invent and deliver scalable methodologies for security testing of AI applications and AI capabilities (e.g. MCP, skills), including adversarial robustness evaluation, safety guardrail bypass detection, tool-use authorization boundaries, and trust boundary verification.

4. AI Asset Discovery & Inventory
Research and build scalable techniques to automatically discover, identify, and catalog all AI-enabled applications, services, and capabilities across the company—maintaining a comprehensive, continuously updated database of AI assets.


Key job responsibilities
Invent
• Identify and frame new research challenges in AI security where problems are ill-defined and require novel scientific paradigms at the product level.
• Contribute to the team's scientific agenda for agent monitoring, protection, remediation, validation research, and AI asset discovery.
• Publish research results at peer-reviewed internal and external venues (e.g., USENIX Security, ACM CCS, IEEE S&P, NeurIPS, ICML security workshops, ICSE, PETS) when appropriate.
• Articulate key scientific challenges of current and future AI security threats and deliver novel research to address them.
• Design, implementation, and successful delivery of scientifically complex security solutions into production—both brand new systems and evolutions of existing ones.
• Write significant portions of critical-path code for detection models, validation engines, protection technologies, and asset discovery / classification systems.
• Assess and select appropriate technologies (e.g., data protection, private inference, graph-based anomaly detection, NLP-based service classification, code/traffic analysis for AI fingerprinting) for production systems.
• Use best practices in scientific methodology and software engineering across the team; provide insightful peer reviews of code, design, and architecture artifacts.
• Deliver solutions that are inventive, maintainable, scalable, and extensible.
Influence
• Autonomously drive discussions with security engineers, software engineers, product managers, and scientist peers across multiple teams.
• Build consensus on larger cross-team security initiatives and factor complex efforts into independent workstreams.
• Identify and resolve endemic problems, including areas where current security tooling limits innovation of partner teams.

title: Process/Design Engineer Amazon Logistics, EU Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon opened its virtual doors in 1995 and strives to be the world’s most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online. The goal of Amazon Logistics is to build a world class last mile operation. Amazon Logistics aims to exceed the expectations of our customers by ensuring that their orders, no matter how large or small, are delivered as quickly, accurately, and cost effectively as possible.
The European Amazon Logistics team is seeking an experienced, innovative, hands on and customer obsessed Process Engineer to drive standardization, integrating the latest technologies in our Delivery Stations and proposing new innovation initiatives.

As a member of the EU Amazon Logistics Engineering team you will be responsible for designing the new Delivery Stations, whilst also supporting process optimization and new technologies integration in the legacy sites, improving safety, customer experience, quality and cost. You will act as a key point of contact for your area of responsibility in the country you support; frequently partnering with local Operations teams as well as other operational support functions.

This position requires deep customer focus, strong self-motivation and exceptional project management skills. It will involve regular communication with customers and project sponsors at both the European and country level, and requires you to be detail-oriented and comfortable partnering across functional business and technical teams. To be successful in this role, you need to pair strong analytical skills and a data-driven outlook with strong design and innovation operations intuition.
This role will involve frequent domestic travel and you will report into the Manager of the Design Engineering team of the country that you will be supporting.

This job is located in Germany with up to 25% of time traveling domestically.

Key job responsibilities
• Drive new site designs and legacy site upgrade designs from planning to execution, including automation integration.
• Lead and drive technology integration and standardization in EU-wide programs and products, owning all layout integrations and optimizations in the assigned Delivery Stations.
• Contribute to network standardization via best practice sharing with EU counterparts.
• Provide process expertise on engineering design defining material flow, conveyor positioning, equipment requirements and real estate implications from process requirements
• Lead strategic initiatives and identify project opportunities to improve the processes and stations designs, engaging and influencing their key stakeholders.

A day in the life
Successful candidate will lead end to end design for new delivery stations and work to improve existing delivery station processes. You will work with multiple internal and external stakeholders, some of the internal stakeholder include operations, design and construction, launch and expansion, and safety.
You will produce best in class layouts for new launches, optimize the existing stations and present to leadership for approval. You will work on automation program to integrate new technologies into legacy stations.
You will lead projects to create mechanisms to improve the stations and come up with innovative solutions to the complex design issues.

About the team

title: Sr. Manager, Solutions Architecture - Data & AI, Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to lead a team defining how enterprises build, govern, and operationalize AI at scale? Are you energized by the full spectrum, from the data foundations that fuel AI systems to the training infrastructure, inference optimization, and agentic architectures that put AI into production?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a senior technical leader to build and lead a team of specialist Solutions Architects focused on Data & AI within our Strategic Accounts organization. Your team will help customers across the full AI stack: modernizing data architectures and governance for AI readiness, optimizing training and inference infrastructure on accelerators, building semantic layers and context graphs that give AI systems business understanding, and designing agentic systems that operate reliably on governed enterprise data. Depending on organizational needs and your strengths, you may focus your team on data foundations, AI/ML infrastructure, or a combination spanning both.

This is a strategic leadership role. You will set technical direction for your team, architect alongside them on the most complex engagements, coach them through conversations with CAIOs, CTOs, and CDOs, and develop the prescriptive points of view that position AWS as the AI strategy partner for our largest customers. You will shape solutions in spaces that are still taking form and bring customer signals back to AWS service teams to influence roadmaps.

Key job responsibilities
Set technical vision and strategic direction for a team of specialist Solutions Architects spanning data architecture, AI/ML infrastructure, and open source domains

Engage directly with customer CAIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and VPs of Engineering as a strategic advisor on AI readiness, data modernization, inference optimization, and emerging patterns such as semantic layers, context graphs, and agentic architectures

Architect solutions alongside your team for complex, multi-service customer environments spanning data governance, accelerator optimization, training and inference infrastructure, and AI application design

Hire, onboard, and develop senior technical talent; build a diverse and inclusive team culture that attracts and retains top performers

Coach team members on architectural thinking, strategic customer engagement, and executive communication across both data and AI domains

Develop prescriptive architectures, reference implementations, and competitive positioning that helps the broader field SA community lead AI and data conversations with their customers

Represent the team externally through conference presentations, published architectures, and technical keynotes that establish AWS credibility across both the data platform and AI infrastructure space

Partner with AWS service teams (analytics, databases, AI/ML, compute, open source) to shape product roadmaps based on customer signals and emerging trends

Collaborate with peer SA leaders, Professional Services, and specialist organizations to deliver unified solutions across the full AI stack

Drive open source engagement and contribution across data and AI ecosystems where it accelerates customer outcomes and builds community trust

A day in the life
You might start the morning reviewing an inference optimization architecture where a customer is deploying foundation models on Trainium clusters, then join a call with the CAIO of a top-25 enterprise to discuss their strategy for grounding agentic systems in governed enterprise data. After lunch, you coach a team member preparing a customer workshop on migrating from a legacy data warehouse to an AI-ready lakehouse on open formats. Later, you finalize a conference talk on how context graphs and semantic layers are changing the way enterprises feed data to AI agents. You close the day aligning with your peer leaders on a shared customer pursuing end-to-end AI readiness, from data foundations through production agents.

About the team
This role sits within the AWS Strategic Accounts Specialist Solutions Architecture organization. The Data & AI organization works across the full modern AI stack: from lakehouse and streaming architectures, through training and inference infrastructure on accelerators, to the semantic and context layers that make production AI reliable and agentic systems trustworthy. You will own a team charter within this organization, with room to shape its direction as customer needs and the technology landscape evolve.

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications listed in this description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

- 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience

- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc.
- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
- Experience hiring, developing, and managing high-performing technical teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in data warehouse technical architectures, data modeling, infrastructure components, ETL/ ELT and reporting/analytic tools and environments, data structures and hands-on SQL coding

title: Principal Audio Scientist, Fauna
descriptionHtml:
Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life, and voice is one of the most natural ways people will interact with them. Cloud speech and language models are good and getting better, but they can only work with the audio they receive, and a robot is a hard place to listen. Its microphones sit beside motors, fans, and moving joints. It speaks through its own loudspeaker while people talk over it. It moves, turns, and shares a room with several people at once. We are hiring a Principal Audio Scientist to be Fauna's technical authority on how our robots hear.

You will design, prototype, and ship the hardest algorithms in the robot's audio system. You will set the audio architecture that other engineers build on, shape hardware decisions across robot generations, mentor the engineers and scientists working on audio, and be the person teams come to when the robot can't hear.

Key job responsibilities
- Set the long-range science roadmap and technical architecture for the robot's audio system, and serve as Fauna's primary technical authority on robot hearing

- Design and implement suppression of the robot's own noise from motors, fans, and moving joints

- Design and implement echo cancellation for the robot's own voice, so people can interrupt it naturally

- Develop multi-microphone processing that holds up as the robot and the people around it move, including locating who is speaking so the robot can turn toward them

- Make on-robot listening decisions robust to internal and external noise sources: wake word, voice activity, and whether speech is directed at the robot

- Drive microphone and speaker placement, enclosure acoustics, and vibration isolation decisions with mechanical, electrical, and industrial design, backed by your own measurements

- Design the robot-specific data collection and evaluation methods to validate the performance of our audio design

- Present audio science and its tradeoffs to senior leadership and partner teams

- Mentor scientists and engineers, raising the scientific bar for audio across the organization through design reviews, code reviews, and hiring

Basic qualifications

- Experience influencing multiple stakeholders and leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
- PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Acoustics, or a related field and 7+ years of relevant research experience after degree, or a Master's degree and 12+ years of equivalent experience
- Deep, hands-on expertise in multi-microphone audio processing, such as beamforming, echo cancellation, and noise suppression
- Track record of designing and shipping audio front-end algorithms on a physical device with its own acoustic challenges, such as a smart speaker, wearable, vehicle, or robot
- Experience influencing hardware decisions on microphone array design and acoustic integration

Preferred qualifications

- Experience suppressing device-generated noise from motors, fans, or mechanical vibration
- Experience with sound source localization or tracking moving talkers
- Experience adapting wake word or voice activity detection to noisy, far-field conditions
- Experience optimizing audio algorithms for real-time execution on embedded or edge hardware
- Experience with robotics, or with sensor fusion that combines audio with other sensors such as cameras or joint state
- Experience mentoring scientists and engineers
- Publications and/or patents in audio or speech processing

title: Transportation Specialist
descriptionHtml:
NOC (Network Operations Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Specialist
A Trans Ops Specialist at NOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at NOC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.

A Trans Ops Specialist provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form. Trans Ops Specialist should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

· Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed is a plus.
· Develop and/or understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
· Ability to scope out business and functional requirements for the Amazon technology teams who create and enhance the software systems and tools are used by NOC.
· Must be able to quickly understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions that make sense based on available data.
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
· Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and identifying activities performed.
· Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum.
- Providing real-time customer experience by working in 24*7 operating environment.

- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative/technical field such as computer science, engineering, statistics
- Experience with Excel

Preferred qualifications

title: HR Business Partner, Sub-Same Day Fulfillment Centers (SSD-FC)
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Business Partner provides HR generalist support to a large population of hourly employees and business leaders, bringing expertise in leadership development, employee experience, and operational excellence.

In this role, you will partner with business leaders to deliver HR initiatives focused on talent management, employee engagement, and internal customer service. Success requires leveraging data-driven insights and understanding the importance of HR metrics to drive business impact. You may also lead a team of entry-level HR employees and own projects that enhance the employee experience.

The HR Business Partner balances strategic and tactical responsibilities, driving organizational success through partnership with leaders. They execute core PXT processes while providing guidance on talent processes, performance management, and cultural initiatives. By building trust and influence through sound business acumen, they manage increasingly complex issues and deliver solutions that enhance both employee experience and business outcomes.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.

Key job responsibilities
- Improve site effectiveness by identifying systemic patterns, addressing root causes, and making high-judgment decisions that align with policy intent while minimizing risk. Establish and implement mechanisms that ensure consistent, fair application of policies while maintaining compliance with evolving regulations.

- Use data analytics to identify emerging trends, predict future challenges, and implement proactive solutions at the site level. Turn insights into practical initiatives that drive measurable improvements in employee experience and business performance.

- Execute and monitor employee engagement strategies and recognition programs. Maintain meaningful floor presence to gather insights, identify early signs of disengagement, and partner with leaders to drive targeted improvements.

- Coach Business Leaders on effective people management practices, including performance feedback, team development, and complex employee relations matters. Support leaders in building inclusive, high-performing teams.

- Partner with leaders to ensure equitable talent practices across selection, development, and advancement decisions. Champion initiatives that create an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive.

- Drive adoption of HR technology solutions, AI, and self-service tools, ensuring effective utilization while maintaining focus on high-touch service delivery in critical moments. Identify opportunities to enhance user experience and process efficiency.

A day in the life
Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic thinking and data-driven decision-making. You'll focus on driving organizational effectiveness and employee engagement, leveraging advanced analytics and AI-enabled tools to identify trends, anticipate business needs, and develop solutions that enhance workplace experience and deliver measurable results.

From coaching leadership teams on workforce and talent management to driving HR process excellence, you'll collaborate with business leaders to develop forward-looking strategies focused on operational objectives and team effectiveness. You'll build strong partnerships across all levels of the organization while contributing to meaningful workplace improvements.

Success in this role comes from your ability to navigate organizational dynamics, lead change initiatives, and make high-judgment decisions in ambiguous situations. Through a combination of business acumen, data-driven insights, and strategic partnerships, you'll help create a workplace culture where employees feel valued and empowered, while driving long-term organizational success and adaptability in a rapidly evolving business landscape.

About the team
Sub-Same Day Fulfillment Centers (SSD-FC) are an integral part of meeting Amazon’s customer promise through Prime same-day delivery. In tandem with its Rapid and Rural Logistics business parallels, these locations strive to serve over 80% of Prime customer demands across North America. – And with people at the heart of it all, our commitment to provide HR functional excellence continues and grows.

Known as People, Experience and Technology (PXT) , our HR team members are present onsite to help drive tactical leadership direction, while providing top-notch internal customer support. PXT teams are flexible, thoughtful, socially responsible, and are always planning for the future.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience supporting operational environments (manufacturing, distribution, or similar)

- Demonstrated ability to build effective partnerships with business leaders

title: Technicien/ne Sécurité au Travail
descriptionHtml:
Assurer la sécurité et le bien-être de nos collaborateurs au travail est une priorité absolue chez Amazon. Nos Techniciens de Sécurité jouent un rôle essentiel dans ce domaine. Ce poste est l'occasion de débuter votre carrière dans la sécurité au travail et de vous développer au sein d'une entreprise internationale. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec nos experts pour surveiller votre site, ce qui vous permettra de constater chaque jour l'impact de votre travail sur le bien-être de chacun.

Key job responsibilities
- Effectuer des évaluations de risques et des audits
- Surveiller le site pour s'assurer que les processus sont conformes aux procédures de sécurité d'Amazon
- Créer et mettre à jour des rapports sur les indicateurs de sécurité pour vos collègues
- Collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles et d'autres services sur des tâches liées à la sécurité et offrir des conseils sur les processus
- Soutenir la mise en place de nouvelles mesures de sécurité

A day in the life
Vous travaillerez sur l'un de nos sites. Cela signifie que vous pourrez suivre de près ce qui se passe et que les collaborateurs pourront facilement vous poser des questions pendant leurs postes. Ce rôle consiste avant tout à repérer les problèmes potentiels avant qu'ils ne surviennent. Vous passerez beaucoup de temps à vérifier le site et à comprendre comment les collaborateurs utilisent les équipements. En comprenant le fonctionnement de chaque tâche et de chaque machine, vous serez en mesure de trouver la meilleure façon de garantir la sécurité des processus. Vous serez également l'une des personnes chargées de mettre en œuvre les changements en matière de sécurité, ce qui signifie que vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec de nombreuses personnes. En plus de vos tâches quotidiennes et hebdomadaires, vous apporterez votre soutien à notre équipe Operations sur des missions ponctuelles liées à la sécurité.

About the team
L'équipe Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) joue un rôle essentiel pour garantir le bien-être mental et physique de nos collaborateurs au travail. Notre équipe travaille avec les responsables, les associés et les administrations locales sur l'ensemble de nos sites, en assurant le respect des politiques d'Amazon et des réglementations légales, et en garantissant la sécurité de nos environnements de travail. L'équipe offre une variété d'opportunités, des Techniciens de Sécurité aux Responsables de Programmes.

Basic qualifications

- DUT HSE (Hygiène, Sécurité, Environnement) ou BUT (Licence) en HSE
- Expérience pertinente dans l'utilisation de l'analyse de données pour générer et expliquer des indicateurs
- Connaissance de la législation française en matière de santé et sécurité au travail

Preferred qualifications

- Maîtrise du français et connaissances de base en anglais (A2), à l'écrit et à l'oral
- Expérience avec les méthodologies Lean, 5S ou Kaizen
- Expérience dans la planification ou la gestion d'initiatives écoresponsables
- Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. title: Cloud Hardware Development Engineer - Manufacturing Test Engineering, Annapurna Labs, Manufacturing Test Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Shape the future of AI infrastructure! Join AWS as we scale our Manufacturing Test Engineering team developing comprehensive testing solutions for our innovative AI acceleration hardware, deployed across our global server fleet. Annapurna Labs (our organization within AWS) designs hardware and software that accelerates innovation. Our custom chips, accelerators, and software stacks enable breakthrough performance in cloud computing, helping customers solve previously impossible challenges.

We're expanding our AI Hardware Test Organization and seeking a Manufacturing Test Engineer to develop, deploy and sustain the tests that qualify the boards, sleds and systems inside our machine learning training systems. In this role you will own test development for assigned products and test insertions — writing test plans, building automated test suites, validating them against known-good and known-bad units, and deploying them to our manufacturing partners. You will work alongside hardware designers, software engineers, and manufacturing operations throughout the product development cycle, and you will own your tests once they are running on the line: triaging failures, closing coverage gaps, and keeping stations healthy at multiple sites.

Our training systems are built from several kinds of hardware — accelerator baseboards, switching and interconnect sleds, trays, and complete racks — and your assignment will follow the program's needs rather than a single fixed product. What stays constant is the work itself: taking a new or changed design through test development, proving the test catches real defects, and keeping it healthy once a factory is running it at volume.

The ideal candidate pairs a solid understanding of computer systems — host software, firmware, buses and the high-speed interfaces between them, and the board underneath all of it — with solid programming ability, hands-on hardware debug skill and a dedication to quality. You are comfortable driving a board or system under real workload rather than only measuring it, and you want to see your test catch a defect before a customer does.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and execute test plans for boards, sleds, trays and systems — from prototype through high-volume production
- Own the functional test content for your assigned products: device and interface enumeration, bring-up, and stability under sustained load
- Design and build automated test suites and station software using Python, C/C++ and shell scripting
- Deploy your tests into high-volume manufacturing and sustain them once deployed, including remote triage of station and test failures at partner sites
- Drive system-level and workload-based functional testing across hardware, firmware and software integration
- Debug failures across the hardware/firmware boundary and perform failure analysis to physical root cause
- Validate new and changed tests against known-good and known-bad units, and correlate testers before release to production
- Analyze test and yield data to identify coverage gaps, and own the corrective action that closes them
- Partner with our contract manufacturers and ODM functional teams to implement test solutions and scale them across sites
- Maintain clear test documentation and procedures for manufacturing teams

A day in the life
Work/Life Balance — We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth — We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

About the team
Annapurna Labs is a wholly owned subsidiary of AWS, focused on developing custom silicon and servers including the Nitro, Graviton, Inferentia, and Trainium families of processors. Machine Learning Annapurna (MLA) functions as a vertically integrated team including software, firmware, hardware, and silicon design in a single organization. We are the Training Servers and Systems organization under MLA, focused on Hardware Development, Software Development, Fleet Ops Systems, and Manufacturing, Quality, and Reliability. This position is in the Manufacturing Test Engineering team.

- 3+ years of integration, testing and automation experience
- Experience building test automation frameworks and tools
- Experience with any programming language such as Python, Java, C++
- Experience in a Linux or Unix environment
- Experience with general troubleshooting/debugging of hardware
- Experience in manufacturing, process, or industrial engineering

Preferred qualifications

- Experience programmatically testing products, measuring test coverage, developing the best automation, driving testability and diagnostic
- Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
- Experience collecting, analyzing, and utilizing data to drive process and system improvements

title: Senior Risk Manager, INFORM Act, Account Compliance Risk
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an experienced compliance professional to join the Account Compliance Risk & Quality (ACRQ) team within Amazon's 1st Line of Defence, providing dedicated, independent risk oversight of the INFORM Consumers Act program. The INFORM Act requires online marketplaces to collect, verify, and disclose information about high-volume third-party sellers to protect consumers from fraud and illicit goods.

Sitting within Account Compliance Risk, the role operates independently from the teams responsible for day-to-day execution of INFORM requirements and controls. You will provide senior-level regulatory risk judgement and an independent view of compliance and risk exposure to senior leadership and governance forums. You are the person who sees the full picture across Legal, Technology, Program, and Operations, connects the dots across workstreams, and raises red flags when the program's risk posture is trending in the wrong direction. The team is actively building AI-powered risk assessment tools and automated monitoring frameworks, and you will be expected to engage with and help shape how these capabilities are applied to oversight work.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and maintain the INFORM Obligation Register and Compliance Requirements Document (CRD), ensuring all regulatory requirements are mapped, current, traceable to controls, and translated into actionable compliance requirements for programme teams.
- Provide independent, evidence-based assessment of the end-to-end INFORM risk and control environment, covering seller identification, verification, certification, disclosure, enforcement, and reporting. Review and challenge control design and operating effectiveness using monitoring results, operational metrics, incidents, and complaints.
- Identify emerging risks, systemic weaknesses, and concentrations of regulatory exposure. Lead regulatory horizon scanning, translate changes into impacts for the control environment, and maintain risk appetite thresholds and escalation mechanisms in partnership with Legal.
- Produce clear, decision-oriented risk reporting for senior leadership and governance forums covering current exposure, control effectiveness, issue health, and direction of travel. Support regulatory enquiries and examinations where required.
- Drive continuous improvement of the oversight framework through data and automation, manage dependencies with adjacent domains such as KYC, seller experience, and data privacy, and hold programme teams accountable for timely remediation through structured escalation.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with a question you return to every day: does the compliance picture people believe match the evidence underneath it? Before the US comes online, you use the quiet hours to look past the dashboards, not to read the green, but to test whether it is real or whether a control is quietly drifting behind a reassuring number.

Mid-morning you are building the oversight framework itself, defining how obligations map to controls, how risk is assessed and calibrated, and how a signal travels from a monitoring exception to a decision in front of leadership. After lunch the work turns live. You join Program, Technology, and Legal partners across time zones, often as the only person on the call holding the regulatory-risk lens, and you challenge whether a change lands cleanly against an INFORM obligation before it ships.

About the team
The ACRQ team provides independent risk oversight of some of Amazon's most significant regulatory compliance programs. We are a small, senior team operating across multiple entities, jurisdictions, and regulatory regimes, working closely with Legal, second line of defence, programme teams, and senior leadership. Over the past year we have invested heavily in AI-powered risk assessment and automated monitoring, and that investment is accelerating.

This role is a genuine springboard. The combination of regulatory expertise, independent oversight, and senior stakeholder engagement prepares you for compliance leadership or broader risk positions. The INFORM space is still evolving, so you will have the opportunity to shape the framework rather than inherit a settled one. If you want to do work that matters at a global scale and grow while doing it, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience within financial services and payment institutions
- Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion

Preferred qualifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
- Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent
- Master's degree or equivalent

This requires teams in CloudWatch to innovate at an unprecedented scale. In CloudWatch we love giving customers what they want: high quality, highly usable, highly available services. It's humbling and energizing to work with excellent, dedicated engineers to build and deliver world-leading service monitoring solutions at AWS scale.

We're looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we've been building.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer for the CloudWatch organisation, you will work in an agile team to design, build and maintain highly available, massively scaled systems used by millions of users worldwide. You will design and implement complex software to the highest quality for the services you and your team own, building our telemetry collection agents in Rust and Go and engaging with the upstream open-source communities, such as OpenTelemetry, that our software is built on and contributes to.

You will help expand our services across all AWS Regions, and when issues arise you will dive deep to understand the root cause and apply fixes that prevent them recurring. You will leverage GenAI and AI-powered development tools to enhance your productivity while staying current with emerging technologies, and you will also mentor junior engineers, helping grow the technical capability of the team.

A day in the life
On a typical day you might root-cause a collection issue affecting a fleet of hosts, ship a new feature in one of our agents, take a change upstream to OpenTelemetry, or design a solution to a performance or footprint problem you have never seen before. You translate customer and internal requirements into designs, weigh the tradeoffs, and break the work into incremental deliverables your team can ship. A strong community of senior and principal engineers gives direct feedback and pushes your thinking. You are surrounded by people who are passionate about observability and who believe there is still a lot of ground to cover in helping developers, SREs, and operators understand their systems.

About the team
We own telemetry collection for CloudWatch: the agents that run on millions of hosts and containers across AWS and gather the metrics, logs, and traces that everything else in CloudWatch is built on. Our software is written in Rust and Go and built on OpenTelemetry, and we contribute back to those open-source communities. We are a growing team in Dublin, and our mission is to give every AWS customer a reliable, low-overhead way to collect the telemetry their systems produce.

We invest in growing our engineers from day one. You will be paired with a buddy, work closely with senior and principal engineers.

Basic qualifications

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Hands on programming skills in at least one of the following: Rust, Go, Java, C++, Python

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Open-source enthusiasm and contributions (e.g. a GitHub portfolio, or contributions to projects such as OpenTelemetry)

title: NW Deployment Build Lead I, DC Global Network Delivery
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Network Technician to join our growing team within infrastructure operations. You will work in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network.

The position's responsibilities include capacity scaling support of several data center locations and day to day assistance with capacity management. You will work closely with internal customers and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Network Scaling Leadership and Technical Program Managers. You will leverage your experience supporting large scale, enterprise class networks as well as network implementation and troubleshooting.

As a NW Deployment Build Lead I you will work in a fast paced, collaborative environment with regular peer and customer interaction. In addition to providing management and support of Amazon Web Services vast network infrastructure, Network Technicians establish and follow best practices and refine operational procedures.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


Key job responsibilities
* Build out first level router-aggregates, build the console network for new rooms, and support network scaling projects
* Any physical requirements are expectations with reasonable accommodations
* Manage work and priorities through ticketing system and workflows to complete customer requests and projects
* Collaboration with various stake holders to remove project obstacles
* Troubleshoot networking, routing and inter connectivity issues, including troubleshooting of network device configuration and low level application interaction
* Up to 60% travel within geographical work area is required. Some travel outside traditional work area may be requested, including internationally
* Troubleshooting cabling infrastructure connectivity issues, including patch panels and patch cords.
* Specifying Power and Cooling requirements and ensuring Hardware Racking/Stacking completed for new equipment
* Participate in the migration, basic configuration and rollout of new or upgraded hardware
* Moving and lifting computer equipment up to 50 lbs

A day in the life
Our team has three primary tasks:
1. Providing the first level networking devices to serve our customer racks entails various tasks (the name of the game is efficiency): You will track network rack intake and delivery; work with various onsite teams to request for rack space, power, and cooling for network racks. And then partner with network engineers to ensure all configurations are ready. You'll also be working on link and device troubleshooting within a certain Service-Level Agreement
2. There is also console builds (and room builds) that are really exciting. You'll be exposed to more teams whose goal is to provide more space and capacity for customer racks.
3. Work with ID-Scaling peers to build higher-level networking devices.

About the team
Our Philadelphia Region is expanding into an ML Cluster, and we are very excited to expand our team with dedicated Infrastructure Deployment Technicians to help our scaling our network and server capacity.

This team covers the whole Pennsylvania region with all the sites inside and outside the perimeter. There is travel involved as we move where the capacity is needed.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
