title: Production Associate Director, Audible Japan
descriptionHtml:
At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

ABOUT THE ROLE
The Production Associate Director leads the end-to-end production lifecycle of audiobooks, audio content, and Audible Originals for the Japan market—from planning through recording, post-production, quality assurance, and final delivery.

You will own the production strategy for the Japan team, optimizing quality standards, budgets, and schedules across the entire portfolio. You will develop and mentor team members to elevate overall performance and capabilities.

You will collaborate with internal teams (Content, Content Operations, Business Affairs, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Metadata) and external partners (studios, narrators, directors, authors, publishers) to drive production. You will proactively leverage AI technologies, production management systems, and workflow automation to streamline operations.

This role is based in our Tokyo office and requires regular in-office presence.

ABOUT YOU
You are a seasoned production leader who thrives at the intersection of audio storytelling and operational strategy. You bring deep experience managing complex production portfolios across multiple stages—from pre-production through final delivery—and you are energized by the challenge of optimizing workflows at scale.

You are comfortable working across cultures and time zones, and you communicate effectively in both Japanese and English. You are curious about AI and digital tools and see them as a way to unlock new efficiencies for your team. You care about developing the people around you and building sustainable, scalable processes.

As a Production Associate Director you will...
- Develop and execute the Japan production strategy—annual plans, capacity planning, partner strategy, and cost optimization—aligned with senior leadership; manage production budgets, purchase orders, cost projections, and variances in coordination with Finance and Content Operations
- Manage team goal-setting, performance, career development, and mentoring to build team capabilities
- Define and monitor production KPIs (quality, cost, lead time, throughput) and implement data-driven improvements
- Lead cross-functional collaboration with Content Acquisition, Marketing, and Product teams on production prioritization and resource allocation
- Partner with the global Production organization to share best practices and localize global tools and processes for Japan
- Oversee production plans, schedules, budgets, and quality standards across the portfolio, managing all stages from recording through editing, mixing, mastering, QA, and delivery; directly manage high-complexity or high-priority titles
- Develop long-term partnership strategies with external studios, narrators, and creators; lead new partner identification and evaluation
- Identify portfolio-wide risks, delays, and capacity constraints; develop contingency plans and risk management frameworks; report production status, milestones, and risks to stakeholders including senior leadership through regular reviews and escalation processes
- Support Content Operations on contracts, rights, vendor registration, metadata, and distribution readiness
- Identify bottlenecks and person-dependent processes; lead scalable improvements with quantifiable outcomes
- Leverage AI and digital tools (generative AI, audio analysis, transcription, automation platforms) to optimize production workflows; develop the team’s AI adoption roadmap and digital literacy
- Ensure compliance with copyright, data protection, information security, and internal policies when using AI and digital tools

ABOUT AUDIBLE
Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in team management and building (including coaching and mentoring)
- 8+ years of experience in audiobook production, audio content, publishing, broadcasting, film/video, or a related industry
- Experience with full production lifecycle management from planning and pre-production through recording, post-production, QA, and delivery across multiple titles, with experience overseeing a production portfolio or leading a production team
- Project management skills managing multiple titles, studios, talent, and deadlines in parallel, including workload allocation and priority-setting for team members
- Experience with stakeholder management including coordination, negotiation, and reporting to senior leadership to support decision-making
- Experience developing production strategies, capacity plans, and cost optimization initiatives
- Data-driven approach to managing budgets, schedules, quality, and risks, with proficiency in production management tools, spreadsheets, and dashboards
- Experience leveraging AI technologies including generative AI and digital tools to automate and improve workflows, with experience driving team adoption
- Professional proficiency in Japanese with English communication ability for collaboration with global teams
- Knowledge of and commitment to copyright, data protection, and information security compliance

Preferred qualifications

- Experience producing audiobooks, podcasts, audio dramas, or Audible Originals
- Experience in direction, editing, or quality management for Japanese-language audio content

- Experience implementing AI-powered tools such as transcription, audio analysis, and QA automation into production workflows

title: On Site Medical Representative, OMR
descriptionHtml:
El Representante Médico en Sitio (OMR, por sus siglas en inglés) es el profesional de salud responsable de la atención médica de primer contacto en el Centro de Distribución o Estación de Entrega. Su función principal es atender lesiones y malestares de los asociados mediante primeros auxilios, identificar de forma proactiva riesgos ergonómicos y de seguridad en las tareas operativas, y contribuir a la implementación del programa de bienestar del sitio.
#AmazonMexico


Key job responsibilities
• Realizar la clasificación inicial (triaje) de asociados que se presenten con lesiones o malestares, brindar primeros auxilios y, cuando sea necesario, canalizarlos a un proveedor médico externo.
• Documentar y mantener actualizados todos los registros de atención médica proporcionada a los asociados.
• Administrar los botiquines de primeros auxilios: llevar el control de inventario, reabastecer insumos y asegurar que el equipo utilizado esté limpio y en condiciones de uso.
• Capacitar a gerentes y asociados en temas de prevención, primeros auxilios y protocolos de emergencia.
• Elaborar y entregar bitácoras diarias de actividad al equipo de liderazgo del sitio.
• Generar un análisis mensual de todos los incidentes de salud y seguridad ocurridos en el sitio.
• Asistir y participar de forma constante en las reuniones de inicio de turno ("stand-up").
• Rotar turnos según las necesidades operativas del sitio. Este puesto es presencial y no admite trabajo remoto.


A day in the life
Reportarás directamente al Gerente de WHS (Seguridad, Salud y Bienestar en el Trabajo). Serás el representante médico asignado a un sitio específico, donde administrarás la sala de AmCare: atenderás casos de prevención de salud ocupacional y emergencias médicas, gestionarás el inventario y la adquisición de insumos médicos, e inspeccionarás periódicamente el equipo de emergencia (DEA, camillas, botiquines). Serás responsable de mantener la confidencialidad de la información médica de los asociados y de garantizar el acceso controlado a la sala de AmCare.

title: Support Engineer, Identity and Access Management
descriptionHtml:
Do you have a passion for protecting data and ensuring compliance at scale? We are looking for a detail-oriented Support Engineers to join our data protection team, where you will investigate access to Amazon's most sensitive and regulated data. You will independently review SQL queries, access logs, and large datasets to determine compliance with policies and standard operating procedures, making clear determinations that protect customer trust and data integrity.

In this role, you will combine technical investigation skills with stakeholder engagement, interpreting complex access patterns and coaching teams on compliant data handling. You will evaluate access requests against data-handling policies, document findings with clarity and precision, and escalate high-risk cases with sound judgment. This is an opportunity to apply your analytical expertise to meaningful work that safeguards data across one of the world's largest technology platforms.

Key job responsibilities
- Investigate access to sensitive data by reviewing SQL queries and access records to determine what data was accessed and whether that access is compliant with policies and standard operating procedures
- Interpret dashboards, logs, and large code and data sets to reach clear compliance determinations, applying analytical reasoning to identify patterns and assess risk
- Engage stakeholders and other Amazon employees to understand access behavior, remediate non-compliant practices, and share best practices that help them maintain compliance and keep data access safe
- Process access requests to protected data, evaluating internal use cases against data-sharing and data-handling policies to ensure appropriate access controls
- Document investigation findings clearly and concisely, articulating impact, the steps taken, and the current state of each case, and escalate complex or high-risk findings with sound judgment following information security guidelines

A day in the life
Much of your day is investigative work: reviewing SQL queries and access records to determine what data was accessed and whether that access is compliant with policy and standard operating procedures. Some investigations involve engaging stakeholders to understand access, remediate behavior, and coach them on compliance best practices. You will process requests for access to protected data, evaluating use cases against data-handling policy. Where needed, you will write queries to validate findings across datasets. As you build expertise, you will resolve cases independently and seek guidance from experienced engineers when cases are complex or findings are high-risk.

This role includes occasional on-call responsibilities.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training and Career growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We protect Amazon's most sensitive and regulated data by monitoring and investigating access to protected data. Our team is dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of data security and compliance, ensuring that customer and business data remains safe and is accessed only in accordance with established policies.

As part of our team, you will work in a collaborative environment where your investigative work directly contributes to safeguarding data at scale. You will have opportunities to develop your technical and analytical skills, learn from experienced engineers, and play a meaningful role in protecting the data that supports Amazon's mission to be Earth's most customer-centric company.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in SQL
- Knowledge of writing and optimizing SQL queries in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
- Experience troubleshooting problems and offering solutions to streamline complex challenges, or experience working with stakeholders
- Experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau), or experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau
- Experience performing data analysis and troubleshooting data integrity issues
- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or other related discipline, or experience with equivalent introductory technical domain knowledge

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of information security technologies such as security design review, threat modeling, risk analysis, and software testing techniques
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in technical support
- Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership, or experience with external customer interaction

descriptionHtml:

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.


AWS Global Sustainability (AWSGS) is a team of sustainability experts, scientists, engineers, program strategists, and product managers that deliver on our ambition to reach net-zero carbon by 2040 as part of Amazon’s Climate Pledge, as well as manage and report on our sustainability progress more broadly.

You will work across science, engineering, and reporting teams to strengthen the integrity and granularity of AWS's GHG inventory where its needed to support action.

In this role you will be responsible for:

Develop, document, and operationalize new and improved carbon accounting methodologies for both operational and embodied emissions across the AWS infrastructure lifecycle.

Measure the carbon impact of current and future infrastructure and sustainability programs, and effectively communicate results to key decision-makers and leaders.

Responsible for program delivery, developing metrics, internal and audit-ready reporting, and managing data inputs from multiple teams.

Bring a solutions-oriented mindset, offering creative, rigorous, and defensible approaches to measurement challenges.

- Experience developing or applying carbon accounting methodologies (operational and/or embodied carbon)

- Experience working across both technical and business functions

Preferred qualifications

AWS is building Kiro Autonomous Agent —a frontier agent that independently tackles development tasks, maintains context across interactions, and continuously learns from its work. This isn't just another AI tool; it's a fundamental shift in how software gets built and maintained.

We're looking for engineers who want to shape this transformation. You'll work alongside exceptional talent solving novel problems at the intersection of AI and software engineering. The challenges are unique: building systems that operate autonomously, retain context across complex workflows, and improve through experience—all while meeting AWS's exacting standards for scale, reliability, and security.

Your impact will be immediate and visible. You'll ship features that directly improve how developers work. Daily collaboration includes code reviews, mentorship in both directions, and rapid skill development. From day one, you'll have opportunities to lead—whether that's owning projects, defining technical direction, or shaping how the team operates.

This is your chance to build the agent that builds the future.

Key job responsibilities
You'll shape the technical direction and architecture of Kiro Autonomous Agent service. Working directly with customers, you'll uncover real-world development challenges and translate them into product capabilities—staying true to Amazon's customer-obsessed approach. You'll build and operate production systems using industry-leading CI/CD practices, ensuring Kiro Autonomous Agent maintains the reliability and performance our customers depend on.

Your responsibilities span the full lifecycle: from architectural decisions that define how an autonomous agent learns and maintains context, to hands-on development of features that transform how software gets built. You'll balance innovation with operational excellence, making technical choices that enable Kiro to work independently while meeting AWS's standards for scale and security.

Your responsibilities span the full lifecycle: from compiler technologies to agent training and steering to scalable deployment. You'll balance innovation with operational excellence, making technical choices that enable Kiro agents to work smoothly for a wide class of developers while meeting AWS's standards for scale and security.

title: Engineering Operations Technician - Night Shift, Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO)
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection
- This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible work schedule including evenings, overnights, and weekends
- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities

Preferred qualifications

- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field
- 2+ years of data center engineering experience

title: Principal Program Manager - App Release & Platform Policy, Mobile App Foundations
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's mobile shopping app is used by hundreds of millions of customers worldwide and are among the most downloaded applications on both the App Store and Google Play. Behind these apps is Mobile App Foundations, a team within Rendering Foundations that owns the platform infrastructure, release operations, and app-level capabilities that enable thousands of Amazon builders to ship features to customers through a single, shared mobile application. Releasing at this scale means coordinating thousands of builder teams shipping into a single application that serves customers across dozens of global marketplaces. Each app store submission must meet evolving platform, legal, and regulatory requirements, and the cost of getting it wrong is a blocked release that affects every team, and end users at every marketplace.

As a Principal Program Manager within Mobile App Foundations, you will own the end-to-end mobile app release program and serve as Amazon's primary operational interface on app store policy matters. You will build the frameworks, relationships, and processes that make Amazon's mobile shopping apps releasable at a scheduled cadence while ensuring every submission meets various internal and external requirements across all marketplaces we serve.

Key job responsibilities
You will own the mobile release program across iOS and Android, driving the operational cadence that enables thousands of Amazon teams to ship features to customers without release delays. You will serve as Amazon's point of contact for external partner relations on policy matters, building strategic relationships with platform counterparts. You will work directly with Amazon Legal, Business Development, and feature teams that build on Amazon Shopping app to interpret platform policy changes, assess risk, and make high-judgment calls. You will develop proactive policy monitoring frameworks that identify potential submission issues before they cause rejections with a systematic approach. When platform policy conflicts arise, you will frame the tradeoffs clearly for VP-level leadership, recommend a path forward, and drive resolution across organizational boundaries.

A successful candidate brings strong program management instincts, the ability to operate in ambiguous environments, and the judgment to make calls that balance customer experience and business impact. You will influence and align multiple stakeholders across organizational boundaries, represent complex problems simply to leadership, and drive clarity under time constraints where none exists.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- 7+ years of program or project management experience
- 7+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Experience operating in environments with legal, regulatory, or policy constraints that require interpretation and judgment rather than fixed rules

Preferred qualifications

- Experience delivering projects within scope, time, budget and quality
- Experience with mobile app release programs at scale (App Store, Google Play)
- Experience in industries with regulatory or platform policies (mobile, fintech, healthcare, media)

As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of Amazon owned data centers. The Amazon Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:

-Medium and low voltage power systems
-Generators
-UPS
-HVAC (Air Handlers / Exhaust Fans / VFD)
-Chilled Water Systems
-Building Management systems (BMS)
-Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
-Testing and balancing
-Pumps and Hydronic systems

Physical Requirements
Walk job sites in uneven terrain
Work at heights and from ladders
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily
Work in a noisy environment
Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment

Additional Job Requirements
· Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 80% of the year.
· Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.

U.S Citizenship Required

Key job responsibilities
The Commissioning Engineer (CxE) provides testing and validation oversight of AWS data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure. CxEs review design documents, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and manage third-party commissioning vendors in the performance of onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing. They take Ownership of their projects’ successes by Diving Deep to resolve technical issues and having Bias for Action to address everchanging schedule and coordination demands onsite. Additionally, CxEs communicate lessons learned and continuously collaborate on program improvements.

The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects and short timelines.

A day in the life
On a typical project, the CxE works across AWS engineering, capacity delivery, operations, and contractor teams to coordinate site activities, prioritize tasks, and ensure each issue has clear path to resolution. The CxE manages the project commissioning vendor whose primary scope is to identify issues, determine criticality, propose solutions, and document their findings. If project turnover is at risk, the CxE escalates to the appropriate stakeholders. Upon project completion, the CxE will communicate lessons learned to help peers on similar projects in flight and participate in initiatives that drive improvement to the commissioning program.

About the team
The AWS Data Center Commissioning Team (ACx) is a wholly independent business within the DCGS organization. This team of veteran professional Electrical Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Controls Engineers, Architectural Engineers, Project Managers, Operators and seasoned Amazonians are uniquely positioned to provide deeply detailed engineering and operational review and testing of equipment designs, operational functionality and construction practices. We are focused on ensuring the rapid delivery of a quality product while maintaining full transparency, recording metrics of manufacturer/contractor/equipment issues pre-PFHO, and identifying opportunities for all our peers and customers.

descriptionHtml:

title: Food Safety Program Manager II, WWGS Retail Food Safety
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 8, 2026

A typical day centers on keeping the Food Safety Audits programs running smoothly and the 3P auditor relationship healthy and productive. The Program Manager II leads the Worldwide Grocery Stores retail food safety audit program, partnering with a third party audit vendor, food safety analysts, store leadership, and cross functional stakeholders to ensure compliance with FDA Food Code.

Key job responsibilities
The role requires a results-oriented, analytical, customer-service approach to manage the audit program, measure progress, and drive risk management and compliance outcomes.
•Manage the day-to-day execution of the Food Safety Audits programs, including the 3P Food Safety audit cycle — scheduling, coverage, standards alignment, and data integrity; works on one or more projects and may own a program.
•Own accountability to the 3P Food Safety Auditor’s KPI scorecard; monitor audit completion, on-time delivery, scoring consistency, and finding-closure metrics, and act to keep them on target.
•Manage the relationship with the 3P audit provider — align on audit standards and expectations, resolve data and scoring discrepancies, and hold the provider to KPI commitments.
•Analyze and trend large audit data sets from internal and external audits to identify emerging Food Safety risks, recurring violations, and improvement opportunities.
•Verify Food Safety policy and the FDA Food Code are correctly reflected in audit standards, checklists, and scoring criteria.
•Support Food Safety escalations arising from audits; track corrective and preventive actions to closure with Operations stakeholders.
•Optimize audit procedures, processes, and best practices to improve efficiency, data quality, and reporting cycle time.
•Anticipate near-term bottlenecks in the audit program; identify, track, and mitigate immediate issues and risks, escalating when appropriate.
•Write and publish audit performance and trend content for WWGS Business Reviews; convey findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders.
•Collaborate with AMZ & WFM stakeholders to align audit processes with Food Safety policy and Operations needs.
•Stay informed of FDA Food Code updates, regulatory publications, and industry audit benchmarks, and apply them to the audit program.
•Begin to mentor peers and new team members on audit standards, data analysis, and the FDA Food Code.
•Make trade-offs across time, quality, and resources to deliver reliable audit outcomes; decide when to resolve independently versus escalate.

A day in the life
Day-to-day responsibilities include:
•Data governance of internal and third-party audits for stores across the US, Canada, and UK
•Data analysis to identify process gaps and resolution
•Maintaining relevant metrics for a food safety scorecard that measures each store's food safety performance
•Reviewing and resolving clarifications
•Monitor vendor performance through a KPI scorecard
•Ownership of food safety self-audit questions and data
•Creation and publishing of monthly and ad-hoc content for food safety culture (Food Safety Empowerment Teams)

The Retail Food Safety team supports stores and company facilities with Food Safety policy, mechanisms to efficiently embed Food Safety in store processes, and a means to measure compliance. - Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

descriptionHtml:
**THIS ROLE CAN BE BASED IN LONDON, MUNICH, PARIS, MILAN, MADRID, BERLIN, BARCELONA & LUX***

Please refer to req 10578326 for informational request

Have you ever ordered a product on Amazon and wondered how it got delivered to you so fast, and what systems and processes power the whole operation? If so, this role is for you.

The EU Speed team is part of EU Supply Chain, Transportation Planning & Operational Excellence (STEP) organisation, which optimises the EU end-to-end transportation and transfer network.
Our mission: offer the right speed, for the right customer, on the right selection, in the most cost-efficient manner.
• Operations is at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. Each action we undertake is on behalf of our customers, as surpassing their expectations is our passion.
• We improve customer experience through continuously optimising the complex movements of goods from vendors to customers throughout Europe.
• We tackle Amazon's most complex problems, processes, and decisions. We work with fulfilment centers, transportation capacity, topology, connectivity, DEA, finance, and retail teams across EU to improve our logistic infrastructure and algorithms.
• We are obsessed with rethinking our advanced end-to-end supply chain to make our deliveries even faster. Our overall mission: we want Amazon to be the place where customers come to get goods delivered next-day.



Key job responsibilities
We are seeking a Sr. Manager to own the end-to-end strategy, execution, and performance of 1D+ Speed across EU5 and EXP8 markets. This is high-visibility leadership role accountable for speed outcomes that impact day to day our customers.
Our overall mission is simple: we want Amazon to be the place where customers come to get goods delivered next-day. This role is the senior leader who makes that happen. You will own end-to-end Next Day speed to improve customer experience across EU markets. The problem space is broad, the opportunity is not fully defined, and the strategy is yours to set. This is a people manager role: you will lead a team of Program managers and Analyst, while personally driving the multi-year vision and roadmap for Next Day speed improvement. You will distill diverse inputs from large customer segments and cross-functional stakeholders to design and drive the right long-term solution. You will own the Speed metric for 1D and 2D Speed, setting targets, identifying structural headwinds and tailwinds, and driving the cross-functional mechanisms required to close gaps at country and EU level. You deliver with independence and high judgment, distinguishing between one-way and two-way doors to move fast where appropriate and exercise caution where the stakes demand it.

title: Data Center Controls Tech, Floydada , Texas
descriptionHtml:

The candidate will possess technical background and experience in installation, troubleshooting, operations and/or maintenance of field sensors, controllers, wiring, networking and programming associated with the industrial controls systems. The candidate may also have relevant experience operating and maintaining mission critical electrical and mechanical systems. A Controls Technician shall be responsible for participating in the installation, testing, troubleshooting and startup of equipment and controls system associated with the BMS and EPMS system deployment in the data centers. A Controls Technician is expected to actively innovate on behalf of their customers in the area of Data Center building automation.

• Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.

• Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.
• Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.
• Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.
• Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.
• Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.
• Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.
• Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.
• Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.
• Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.
• Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.
• Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.
• Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.
• Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.
• Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.
• Perform other tasks as assigned by manager

· Walk job-sites in uneven terrain and work at heights and from ladders.
· Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch
or crawl.
· On occasions, lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more.

A typical day is attending morning construction/commissioning meetings, assessing and prioritization of project tasks and service tickets for the given day. Field work which requires configuring controllers, testing sensors, troubleshooting, safety site walks, and supporting general startup processes. Technician is responsible for logging their daily efforts in construction and service related AWS tools.

The mission of the Data Center Controls Engineering team is to manage the design, deployment, and service of a highly reliable electrical and mechanical control system for the life-cycle of an AWS data center.

About the team
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.
AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

title: Senior Applied Scientist, GEOS Science Team
descriptionHtml:
This role sits in Business Innovation and AI (BIA), part of Global Ops Enterprise Services (GOES), and works on the Real Estate Optimization System (REOS). REOS decides where Amazon builds. It models the supply chain from fulfillment centers through sort centers and delivery stations to the customer as a time-space network over a 20-year horizon, and ranks candidate sites on total network cost — transportation, labor, real estate and unmet demand — rather than on rent alone. Alongside the core engine we are building a family of AI tools that source candidate properties from across the market, assemble and validate the data behind a study, and generate the cost briefs that explain a recommendation, and we are extending the same optimization to zip-code-level Sub Same Day siting. You will work alongside scientists, and with partner teams in GOES Portfolio Management, Capacity Planning and Finance.
We are looking for an Applied Scientist to own the optimization models behind REOS. You will formulate the models that decide where Amazon builds, engineer the solution methods that make them tractable at network scale, lead the initiatives that extend them, and take the recommendations to the Development Managers and Finance partners who act on them. The work is hands-on and close to the decision: your models become the basis for real capital commitments.
The people who make those commitments are your customers. You will work with Development Managers, Capacity Planning teams and Finance partners to understand what they need, build and run the model that answers it, deliver the result, and explain what it recommends in terms they can act on and defend. Reporting to the Science Manager, you will own the technical approach on the models you build and mentor the scientists working alongside you.


Key job responsibilities
• Formulate and solve large-scale optimization models — linear, mixed-integer, network flow and stochastic or robust variants — that recommend site locations and network topology at lowest total cost.
• Select and engineer the solution methodology — decomposition, column generation, cutting planes, relaxations and heuristics — so models solve reliably at production scale and within business timelines.
• Own the modeling assumptions and the cost structure behind them, and make the trade-offs explicit and defensible to Finance.
• Implement and productionize models in Python against commercial and open-source solvers, with the data pipelines and validation that keep them trustworthy, and maintain them as the network and the data change.
• Engage customers directly: elicit the real problem, translate it into a formulation, run scenarios with them, deliver results, and explain what the model recommends and why.
• Lead initiatives end to end, apply AI tooling to the science workflow, and raise the bar for the scientists around you through design review and mentoring.


A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing experiment results and refining a machine learning model before syncing with engineers on a production integration plan. After lunch, you could be whiteboarding a new algorithmic approach with colleagues from product and science teams, then drafting a research document that outlines your methodology and findings. You will regularly present your work to leadership, participate in science reviews, and stay connected to the latest research in your field to inform your next initiative.

descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about working at the intersection of finance, technology, and strategy for one of AWS's most critical business areas? Join the EC2 Pricing Finance team, where you'll shape pricing decisions for Core EC2 and GenAI workloads that power millions of businesses worldwide. This role goes beyond traditional finance. You will directly influence pricing strategy, capital allocation, and infrastructure economics for GPU and custom silicon platforms including Trainium, and Graviton.

You'll develop deep expertise in AWS infrastructure economics and Gen AI business modeling while becoming a trusted finance partner to EC2 Product, Deal Desk, Service Finance, and executive leadership. Operating in a fast-paced, high-visibility environment, you'll lead complex pricing analyses, support multi-billion-dollar customer negotiations, and drive tooling improvements that underpin EC2's marginal cost models.

This role operates at the strategic level with significant ambiguity. You will influence VP-level decisions on pricing strategy, custom silicon economics, and large-scale customer deal structures. Your recommendations will directly impact P&L outcomes for AWS's fastest-growing business segment.

- Lead and develop a high-performing team of finance managers and senior analysts, setting strategic priorities, coaching talent, and delivering results in a rapidly evolving GenAI business environment
- Lead financial analysis and recommendations for large-scale customer negotiations and deals, synthesizing complex datasets into clear insights that influence multi-billion-dollar business decisions
- Analyze infrastructure cost trends and evaluate pricing impacts across Core EC2 and AI workloads, building complex financial models that inform strategic pricing decisions and investment scenarios
- Partner with Product, Service Finance, and engineering teams to develop and enhance marginal cost models, pricing methodologies, and automated processes that support evolving market conditions
- Support executive leadership reviews by preparing strategic materials, conducting pricing and margin tradeoff analyses, and communicating complex technical and financial concepts to senior stakeholders
- Drive process improvements and innovation in pricing finance mechanisms, collaborating across Finance, Deal Desk, Supply Chain, and Infrastructure teams to enhance accuracy and efficiency of EC2 pricing models

A day in the life
Your day blends strategic analysis with high-impact collaboration across AWS's most critical infrastructure decisions. You might start by analyzing infrastructure cost trends and pricing impacts for emerging Gen AI workloads, then partner with Product teams on investment scenarios that shape multi-million dollar infrastructure decisions. Afternoons often involve supporting active customer deal negotiations, building financial models that evaluate pricing tradeoffs, or preparing executive materials that influence long-term pricing strategy. You'll work with engineering and supply chain teams to refine pricing methodologies while responding quickly to market changes in this dynamic, highly visible role.


About the team
Our EC2 Pricing Finance team sits at the heart of AWS's infrastructure and pricing decisions, supporting some of the company's most strategic business opportunities across both Core EC2 and Gen AI businesses. Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, New Product Success
descriptionHtml:
Third-party sellers account for about 60% of units sold in Amazon's stores. New Product Success helps them identify, launch, and scale new products, and helps customers discover them. Our 100+ person organization builds ML and AI powered products and experiences across the entire new product launch journey - from identifying high-potential opportunities, to guiding sellers toward the right products, to accelerating discovery and conversion in the critical early weeks after launch for all new products launched on Amazon across the world.

You'll be the lead product marketing manager for all of New Product Success - setting marketing strategy across a multi-product portfolio that spans the full seller launch journey. You'll define the narrative, shape annual plans, set marketing goals and metrics, build partnerships inside and outside Amazon, and drive the overall GTM approach.

In addition to leading strategy, you'll go hands-on as the PMM for New Product Accelerator, our post-launch AI powered experience that helps sellers scale new products through their most critical growth window. The role is both strategic and operational - you'll influence Directors and VPs on where to invest, and then ship the work yourself. For the right person, it's a chance to define how product marketing works in a high-growth, AI-driven product organization.

We are looking for a marketer who thinks like a single-threaded product leader. You can set strategy for an entire product organization and then go deep on positioning for a single product - in the same week. You're as comfortable analyzing seller sentiment data across cohorts as you are crafting a mainstage narrative that earns conviction in large conferences. You bring structure to ambiguity, judge success by whether the message landed rather than whether it shipped, and make a complex product suite feel simple and essential. You build mechanisms, not just campaigns, and you see marketing as a system that drives adoption, not just awareness. If you want to shape how sellers think about launching products on Amazon, this is the role.

Key job responsibilities
1. Set marketing strategy for New Product Success end to end. Define the narrative, goals, metrics, and GTM approach across the full product portfolio.

2. Shape annual marketing plans, and ensure every product launch has clear positioning, target segments, and success measures.

3. Lead partnerships inside and outside Amazon. Build relationships with ecosystem partners, industry publications, and internal stakeholders that extend New Product Success's reach and credibility with sellers.

4. Own the seller satisfaction signal. Design and run the measurement framework for seller sentiment across the product suite, and turn insights into inputs for roadmap decisions.

5. Own the New Product Success narrative at Amazon Accelerate, our flagship global conference. Lead track strategy, content, mainstage and breakout messaging, multi-VP stakeholder alignment, speaker preparation, and claims review.

6. Own product marketing for New Product Accelerator. Go hands-on as the PMM for our post-launch experience - positioning, messaging, go-to-market, and full-funnel adoption from seller awareness through activation and sustained usage.

7. Close the loop between marketing and product. Make sure feedback from surveys, campaigns, events, and partners reaches product teams as actionable input, not just data.

8. Build mechanisms that scale. Create repeatable processes for launch planning, messaging, campaign execution, and post-launch measurement that raise the bar across the PMM team.

9. Communicate impact to senior leadership. Own marketing performance in business reviews, tie awareness and satisfaction to business outcomes, and build the narrative that earns investment.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience leading go-to-market for consumer software or hardware product launches
- Experience building scalable marketing mechanisms (launch playbooks, campaign frameworks, measurement templates) that outlast individual campaigns
- Experience using generative AI tools in marketing workflows, with willingness to learn effective prompting and evaluation practices

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
- Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting
- Experience in product marketing for SaaS, marketplace, or seller-facing products

title: HR Associate Partner, Fixed-term, PXT
descriptionHtml:
**Dies ist ein 2-Jahres-Vertrag.**

Im Streben danach, der beste Arbeitgeber der Welt zu sein, treiben unsere globalen Human-Resources-Teams – bekannt als People eXperience and Technology (PXT) – den Unternehmenserfolg voran, indem sie eine sichere, inklusive und innovative Unternehmenskultur fördern. Die Rolle des Associate Partners bietet einen Einstieg in den HR-Bereich bei Amazon und konzentriert sich auf grundlegende HR-Prozesse sowie die direkte Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden. Der Associate Partner sorgt für außergewöhnliche Mitarbeitererlebnisse, indem er sowohl menschliche Expertise als auch technologische Lösungen einsetzt. Er verwaltet wesentliche HR-Transaktionen und baut gleichzeitig bedeutungsvolle Verbindungen zu Mitarbeitenden in einem zunehmend digitalen Arbeitsumfeld auf. Diese Rolle ergänzt Amazons sich weiterentwickelnde PXT-Servicekanäle – von KI-gestützten Systemen bis hin zu persönlichen Supportoptionen – indem sie dort personalisierte Unterstützung und menschliche Nähe bietet, wo diese am wertvollsten sind. Durch die effektive Balance zwischen technologiegestützten Prozessen und bedeutungsvoller Interaktion tragen sie dazu bei, ein nahtloses PXT-Erlebnis zu schaffen, das Amazons Engagement, der beste Arbeitgeber der Welt zu sein, weiter stärkt.

Zu deinen Hauptaufgaben gehören die Bearbeitung von HR-Transaktionen, das Management von Zeit- und Anwesenheitsfragen sowie die grundlegende Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden – bei komplexeren Anliegen erfolgt die Weiterleitung an erfahrenere Kolleginnen und Kollegen. Je nach Bedarf bist du als Associate Partner für mehrere Standorte innerhalb deiner geografischen Region (Cluster) zuständig und fungierst als erste Anlaufstelle für grundlegende HR-Anfragen. Als Associate Partner im One PXT Team trägst du dazu bei, durch jede Interaktion ein herausragendes Mitarbeitererlebnis zu gestalten. Die Rolle erfordert eine einladende und zugängliche Präsenz sowie die präzise und zeitnahe Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden zu Themen wie Benefits, Unternehmensrichtlinien und Gehaltsabrechnung.

Du wirst vor Ort an einem Amazon-Standort arbeiten. Bedarfsorientiert unterstützt du temporär auch umliegende Standorte.


Key job responsibilities
• Reaktionsschnelle, freundliche und professionelle Unterstützung der Mitarbeitenden über verschiedene Kanäle (persönlich, digital, per E-Mail, telefonisch) – mit genauen und zeitnahen Informationen zu Benefits, Richtlinien, Gehaltsabrechnung und weiteren HR-relevanten Themen.
• Sicherstellung der Genauigkeit, Integrität und Vertraulichkeit von Mitarbeiterdaten durch die sorgfältige und sichere Pflege und Verarbeitung von Unterlagen.
• Beitrag zu einer positiven und inklusiven Unternehmenskultur durch die Unterstützung und Umsetzung von Mitarbeiterengagement- und Anerkennungsinitiativen – einschließlich der Planung und Durchführung von Veranstaltungen, die den Zusammenhalt fördern und Leistungen würdigen.
• Unterstützung datenbasierter Entscheidungsfindung durch die Erhebung, Prüfung und Analyse wichtiger Personalkennzahlen, darunter Anwesenheit, Fluktuation und Engagement.
• Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften und Supportteams, um Mitarbeitende über KI-gestützte und klassische Self-Service-Tools sowie HR-Ressourcen zu informieren und zu schulen – mit dem Ziel, das Mitarbeitererlebnis und die betriebliche Effizienz zu verbessern. Nutzung von KI als primäres Hilfsmittel bei der Recherche und Problemlösung sowie proaktiver Einsatz verfügbarer Ressourcen und interner Netzwerke.
• Erstellung und Veröffentlichung klarer, professioneller interner Kommunikation für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte unter Einhaltung der organisatorischen Standards und des gewünschten Kommunikationsstils.
• Erkennung und Weiterleitung komplexer oder sensibler Anliegen an die zuständigen HR- und Führungsverantwortlichen – darunter Gehaltsabweichungen, Dienstplanungskonflikte, Anträge auf Anpassungen am Arbeitsplatz, Schwerbehindertenangelegenheiten, Abwesenheitsfragen, Vorwürfe von Fehlverhalten, Richtlinienverstöße, rechtliche oder betriebsrätliche Anliegen sowie weitere Mitarbeiterbeziehungsthemen.


A day in the life
Ein typischer Arbeitstag umfasst die Unterstützung von Mitarbeitenden bei der Nutzung unserer digitalen HR-Tools und Self-Service-Plattformen sowie die Bereitstellung reaktionsschneller und professioneller Hilfe bei Bedarf. Du verbringst Zeit auf der Betriebsfläche, coachst Mitarbeitende im effektiven Umgang mit HR-Technologie, beantwortest Fragen zu Richtlinien und Programmen und erkennst Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Self-Service-Nutzung. Unter Anleitung erfahrener Teammitglieder stellst du eine genaue Dateneingabe und Dokumentation sicher und leistest dabei einen außergewöhnlichen Service, der Vertrauen und Sicherheit aufbaut.

Im Laufe deiner Schicht bearbeitest du HR-Transaktionen mit verschiedenen Tools und Systemen, verfolgst Servicekennzahlen und vertiefst dein Verständnis des HR-Betriebs. Bei komplexen Anfragen triffst du fundierte Entscheidungen über geeignete Eskalationswege und arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Teammitgliedern an der Lösung zusammen.

Für den Erfolg in dieser Rolle sind eine ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung, Sorgfalt, ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit zur Wahrung der Vertraulichkeit erforderlich. title: Data Center Controls Tech, Midlothian, Texas
descriptionHtml:
The Data Center Global Controls team is looking for exceptional individuals to join our Controls organization as a Controls Technician for Service & Construction of the Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) within Amazon data centers. If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act globally and have the ability to contribute to major new innovations in the area of building controls and automation this is the challenge you are looking for! The candidate will possess technical background and experience in installation, troubleshooting, operations and/or maintenance of field sensors, controllers, wiring, networking and programming associated with the industrial controls systems. The candidate may also have relevant experience operating and maintaining mission critical electrical and mechanical systems. A Controls Technician shall be responsible for participating in the installation, testing, troubleshooting and startup of equipment and controls system associated with the BMS and EPMS system deployment in the data centers. A Controls Technician is expected to actively innovate on behalf of their customers in the area of Data Center building automation.

Key job responsibilities
• Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.
• Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.
• Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.
• Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.
• Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.
• Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.
• Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.
• Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.
• Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.
• Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.
• Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.
• Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.
• Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.
• Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.

The mission of the Data Center Controls Engineering team is to manage the design, deployment, and service of a highly reliable electrical and mechanical control system for the life-cycle of an AWS data center.

About the team
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.
AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

- Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts and overtime as required.

Preferred qualifications

title: Software Development Manager, Programming Foundations, ASBX
descriptionHtml:
Are you an engineering leader who has defined a bold strategy for your space and delivered on it? Have you built and led teams through transformation where the ambition grew faster than the headcount, and come out the other side with big results? Amazon Software Builder Experience (ASBX) is looking for a Software Development Manager to lead the team, product and engineering strategy, and delivery of transformative testing and verification solutions at agentic scale at Amazon. We are creating new AI systems that decide what to test, write the tests, explain what went wrong, and close the loop fast enough for an agent to self-correct without human intervention.

As a Software Development Manager in ASBX, you will be a product and people leader for products across the Testing suite. You will define the strategy for how AI-powered testing capabilities mature from early adoption (10K+ monthly active users today) into the default way every team at Amazon validates software in the AI Development Life Cycle. You will own the product vision, the roadmap, the team, and the results.

You are joining an experienced team that is already shipping. Your job is to force-multiply it: sharpen the strategy, raise the ambition, grow and support the team, and deliver at a pace that matches how fast the problem is moving. This role requires a leader who has done this before, not someone looking to learn it for the first time.

Key job responsibilities
- Defining and owning the product strategy for AI-driven testing at Amazon: what to build, in what sequence, and why that sequence wins. Your strategy must be defensible to senior leadership and ambitious enough to match the rate at which agents are changing how software gets written;
- Hiring, growing, and leading a large engineering team through a period of rapid expansion and increasing scope;
- Partnering with your SDE, PE, and PM colleagues to translate product direction into technical architecture, and holding both accountable to coherence;
- Meeting with customers across Amazon to understand how they test today, where their testing breaks down, and what would make them trust AI-generated test evidence enough to ship on it;
- Driving delivery execution at a pace that matches the domain. Capabilities in this space that ship six months late ship into a world that moved on;
- Owning the product vision for your area. You partner with a product manager, but the vision, the conviction, and the hard prioritization calls are yours;
- Deeply shaping the direction of TestSpaces, ensuring that the execution layer and the testing-judgment layer evolve as a coherent system rather than adjacent efforts;
- Communicating strategy, progress, and risk to senior leadership clearly and without hedging.

A day in the life
You lead the team building AI testing capabilities already in daily use by tens of thousands of Amazon engineers, and you are pushing those capabilities from useful individual tools into a coherent testing system that operates across the development lifecycle. On a given day you might be: working with a PE on tech strategy; reviewing architecture and tech designs with your engineers; meeting with another Amazon team as your customer; reviewing Go-To-Market progress with our PM, or presenting your roadmap to ASBX leadership and defending the sequencing choices.

Your customers are every builder at Amazon. Your immediate partners are your PE, your product manager, and the teams who own the testing platforms, deployment infrastructure, and AI coding tools that your work builds on and feeds into. The right product decisions in this space compound across the entire company.

About the team
Our group exists to make testing in the AI Development Life Cycle a solved problem rather than a growing liability. In the Testing org, our platforms execute millions of tests per day across every AWS region. Our AI systems make those platforms smarter: generating tests, diagnosing failures, measuring sufficiency, and helping builders ship with confidence. The Pipeline Test Fixer alone has surpassed 50,000 daily invocations and reduces median promotion-blocking time by 25%. TestSpaces is already validated at scale, with a sibling organization running 2 million AI-native end-to-end tests per month across 500+ production pipelines on our execution layer. The capabilities in our strategy range from production to proof-of-concept, and the person who leads this team will decide which of them become products and which get cut.

You will thrive here if you have a track record of defining product strategy in ambiguous, fast-moving technical domains; if you have built and led high-performing engineering teams through periods of growth; and if you have the conviction to make hard calls on what to build, and what to stop building, when the landscape shifts under you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of engineering experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- 3+ years of Software Engineer, Software Developer, or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of providing technical leadership and project management for all aspects of the software development lifecycle experience
- 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using Java, C#, or C++ experience
- 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using service-oriented architecture experience
- 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using distributed programming experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 9, 2026

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on Earth. Amazon is a place where builders can build. We hire the world's brightest minds and offer them an environment in which they can invent and innovate to improve the experience for our customers.

The Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) Data Center Infrastructure Operations organization is looking for an individual with proven skills to join the ADC Facility Operations Center (FOC). The ADC FOC is responsible for 24/7 monitoring of data center physical infrastructure across air-gapped, isolated environments hosting classified workloads with no connection to the public internet.

The ADC FOC Technical Specialist is responsible for ensuring global continuity in training, qualifications, certifications, event management, and program delivery across multiple ADC FOC instances. The role combines technical subject matter expertise in data center infrastructure with the ability to develop and maintain programs that raise the technical bar, drive operational excellence, and deliver measurable improvements to the ADC FOC operation.

The Technical Specialist may own one or more of the following program areas: training development and qualification pathways, event management quality and optimization, or new site launch and colocation program delivery. All Technical Specialists operate as force multipliers for the ADC FOC, ensuring consistent standards, knowledge transfer, and program execution across all regions and partitions.

The ADC FOC Technical Specialist manages medium-to-high impact projects from conception to completion. These projects involve independent work and collaboration with internal and external support groups including engineering, controls, automation, DCEO, and data analytics teams. The role trains and supports ADC FOC engineers in their 24/7 monitoring and alarm notification responsibilities, including implementation of site, equipment, and design-specific training exercises covering EPMS, BMS, controls monitoring equipment, stand-by diesel generators, transformers, switchgear, breakers, UPSs, PDUs, AHUs, chillers, cooling towers, and VFDs.

Operating within air-gapped environments presents unique challenges. The ADC FOC cannot leverage commercial FOC tooling directly, and extracting operational data requires additional controls, engineering systems, and customer approvals. The Technical Specialist will develop ADC-specific solutions, build and maintain programs that scale with the growth of the ADC business, and collaborate with commercial teams to share knowledge and adopt best practices where applicable.

The ideal candidate will act as a subject matter expert in data center infrastructure across various ADC data center designs. They will ensure overall availability and reliability meets or exceeds defined service levels. If you are passionate about the customer experience, think and act globally, and want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon Data Centers, this may be the role for you.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Operate independently with limited direct management across air-gapped ADC environments.
- Act as a technical escalation point for ADC FOC engineers and participate in an on-call rotation.
- Own and deliver one or more global ADC FOC programs, which may include but not limited to: training development and qualification pathways, event management quality and optimization or new site launch and colocation program delivery.
- Design, create, and launch learning content, practical assessments, workshops, web-based training, and instructor-led training programs. Measure and report on training health across all regions.

- Locate systemic infrastructure issues using data-driven analysis to drive solutions.
- Develop, update, and maintain ADC FOC runbooks to ensure consistent processes across all regions.
- Refine existing processes and create new standard processes for ADC FOC engineers and Team Leads. Create and maintain all ADC FOC technical documentation globally.
- Liaise with commercial FOC teams to share knowledge, adopt best practices, and align processes where applicable.
- Conduct drills that are region, building, or design-specific and identify team and individual growth opportunities. Establish performance benchmarks and conduct audits to drive effectiveness.
- Coordinate with partner teams during new site launches to ensure seamless implementation of FOC services and reduce burdens on existing operational workloads.
- Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience. Deliver global projects while influencing stakeholders through reports, process improvements, and narratives.
- Drive ownership of organizational and team-level goals.
- Mentor and guide the career growth of ADC FOC team members across regions.
- Work outside normal business hours to support the 24/7 operation of the ADC FOC.
- Travel is required.

The ADC FOC Technical Specialist operates across multiple ADC regions and clusters in air-gapped environments. Depending on the specialism, a typical day may involve reviewing event data and AARs to identify improvement opportunities, developing training content for upcoming qualification assessments, coordinating new site launch milestones with partner teams, progressing program deliverables, or collaborating with controls, DCEO, and commercial FOC teams. descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:

This role will work closely with the Head of Creative Services, Sr. Creative Producers, Graphics Producers and the Creative Services Graphics Coordinator to support the entire Live Sports Production team with live game and studio graphics projects.

The Graphics Associate Producer will provide support for day-to-day show graphics requests while managing creative and sponsorship assets in a fast-paced environment on live event productions across multiple sports properties. Additional responsibilities include development of delivery mechanisms and communication processes to internal and external stakeholders including vendors, remote and studio crews or third party production providers.
