title: Responsable maintenance (H/F), Responsable Facility Management (F/H), Maintenance, Robotique & Systèmes Automatisés
descriptionHtml:
Au sein de l'équipe RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering), vous intégrerez le moteur de l'innovation chez Amazon. Notre mission ? Faire en sorte que chaque infrastructure, chaque installation technique, chaque espace évolue au rythme d'Amazon pour garantir que des millions de clients reçoivent leurs commandes à temps, chaque jour.

En tant que Responsable Facility Management, vous aurez l'opportunité unique de construire, dès l'origine, l'organisation Facility Management du site : Vous piloterez l'ensemble des installations techniques du bâtiment et dirigerez une équipe de 30 experts techniques pluridisciplinaires en gestion directe, tout en supervisant plus de 20 prestataires externes.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement où l'excellence opérationnelle n'est pas une ambition, mais une exigence, et où chacune de vos décisions impacte directement la sécurité et la satisfaction de vos équipes et de nos clients.

Vous aimez piloter des installations multi-techniques, manager des équipes et des prestataires, et faire progresser les performances au quotidien ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous.


Key job responsibilities
- Exploitation technique du site : réception, tests et suivi du bon fonctionnement des installations CVC, incendie, air comprimé et espaces verts.
- Santé & sécurité : maintenir une culture sécurité exemplaire (LOTO, Safety Curriculum, toolbox talks), garantir la conformité des installations et viser le zéro incident grave.
- Gestion multi-technique : superviser les systèmes CVC, incendie, air comprimé et espaces verts, en garantissant disponibilité et conformité réglementaire.
- Management d'équipe : encadrer et faire monter en compétences une équipe de 30 techniciens et superviseurs.
- Gestion des prestataires : piloter plus de 20 prestataires externes (contrats, SLA, standards qualité/sécurité Amazon).
- Excellence opérationnelle : piloter la maintenance préventive et corrective et assurer la disponibilité technique des équipements.
- Amélioration continue : analyser la performance des installations, optimiser l'énergie et mener des projets Kaizen/QCC avec les équipes européennes.
- Budgets & projets : gérer le budget Facility Management et piloter les projets d'infrastructure avec les équipes internes (GES, GPO, Central RME) et externes.

A day in the life
Vous serez basé·e sur l’un de nos sites opérationnels, ce qui vous permettra d’être au plus près de votre équipe et d’avoir une vision claire de ce qui se passe sur votre site. Vous collecterez des données et résoudrez les problèmes dans un environnement dynamique. Vous aurez également l’occasion d’élaborer un plan opérationnel visant à rendre le site plus productif et plus efficace. Vous devrez notamment mettre en place de nouveaux projets visant à améliorer les processus opérationnels et l’entretien du matériel. Après la sécurité, la fonction la plus importante de votre rôle consistera à diriger votre équipe et à gérer ses performances et son évolution, notamment en mettant en place des formations.

About the team
Notre équipe d’ingénieurs RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) veille à ce que nos équipements fonctionnent au mieux. Guidés par des responsables expérimentés, nous sommes une équipe à l’esprit analytique. Nos collaborateurs·trices possèdent à la fois des connaissances techniques poussées et un bon esprit d’équipe. Nous travaillons ensemble pour assurer l’entretien, le dépannage et la réparation des ressources de notre réseau mondial de centres d’expédition. Certains de nos employé·es occupent des postes à responsabilités et sont chargés de superviser l’équipe dans son travail sur des technologies passionnantes, dont certaines n’existent que chez Amazon.
De l’installation de systèmes d’emballage automatisés à la supervision de la maintenance générale d’un site, en passant par la réparation d’équipements de distribution essentiels, notre équipe assure le bon fonctionnement de la plupart des éléments techniques d’Amazon. Nous veillons, par exemple, à ce que les bâtiments soient conformes à la législation, afin d’assurer la sécurité de tous et le fonctionnement à plein régime de nos sites. Les possibilités d’évolution sont nombreuses, tant au sein de l’équipe RME qu’à l’échelle d’Amazon.
Tout ce que nous faisons vise à réduire les temps d’arrêt dans les principaux sites logistiques d’Amazon, afin que les clients reçoivent leurs commandes à temps. Nous travaillons souvent tôt ou tard pour effectuer les tâches de maintenance avec un minimum de perturbations, y compris en équipes de nuit. Si nous voyons qu’il existe une méthodologie plus aboutie pour faire les choses, nous avons les compétences nécessaires pour développer et introduire des processus nouveaux ou des technologies de pointe, comme Amazon Robotics ou notre robot de tri ultra sophistiqué.

Basic qualifications

- - Une expérience préalable en Facility Management ou gestion multi-technique de bâtiments (CVC, incendie, air comprimé, espaces verts)
- - Une expérience préalable dans le management direct d'une équipe (idéalement 20+ collaborateurs)
- - Une expérience préalable dans la gestion et la coordination de prestataires externes multiples
- - Une expérience préalable dans des projets de création ou d'ouverture de site est un plus
- - Parfaite maîtrise du français et niveau courant anglais à l'oral et à l'écrit
- - Connaissance des réglementations statutaires telles que les contrôles de conformité et les protocoles de sécurité incendie et des installations techniques

Preferred qualifications

- - Connaissance approfondie des systèmes CVC, des installations de sécurité incendie et des réseaux d'air comprimé
- - Expérience dans la gestion de contrats de prestations et le pilotage de SLA
- - Expérience dans la mise en service (commissioning) de bâtiments ou d'installations techniques
- - Connaissance des outils d'analyse de données et des systèmes de gestion technique du bâtiment (GTB)
- - Expérience préalable dans la gestion de projets ou des processus Kaizen, Lean, Six Sigma
- - Connaissance des systèmes de gestion de la maintenance assistée par ordinateur (GMAO)

title: Program Manager, Supplier Development, Global Procurement Sustainability
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about using technology to create a positive impact for people and the planet? Are you excited by the challenge of turning fragmented, manual supplier processes into a single, scalable, intelligent experience? Supplier Engagement & Development (SED) — the consolidated supplier-facing function across Amazon's Global Procurement Sustainability organization — is looking for a Program Manager to lead the Digital First Strategy and own the One Supplier Journey program: the technology spine that lets SED engage, develop, and recognize suppliers at scale across Environment, Social Responsibility, Supplier Development & Impact (SDI), and Community Impact.

In this role you will own the strategy and end-to-end delivery of how thousands of suppliers experience Amazon's sustainability expectations — moving them from fragmented, uncoordinated touchpoints across a dozen systems to one coordinated, self-service journey. You will translate SED's strategic priorities (communication consolidation, the Supplier for Good badge program, segmentation, and an integrated supplier portal) into a coherent technology roadmap, and you will partner deeply with Global Procurement Technology (GPT), Global Supplier Management (GSM), the Ada/Quick Suite teams, and each GPS sub-pillar to deliver it.

This is a high-visibility role where a single, well-designed platform decision can change the experience of tens of thousands of suppliers across 20+ countries and directly advance Amazon's sustainability commitments.


Key job responsibilities
- Own the Digital First Strategy for SED: define and maintain the multi-year technology roadmap that consolidates fragmented supplier-facing systems into the One Supplier Journey, sequencing delivery across communications, development, and recognition.
- Serve as SED's named business owner / co-owner for the One Supplier Journey platform and represent SED's equities in cross-organizational technology intake, ensuring supplier engagement, development, and recognition requirements are embedded in relevant roadmap projects rather than added after the fact.
- Translate SED's strategic priorities into scoped, prioritized product requirements: the Supplier for Good (S4G) Badge dashboard, the Supplier for Good (S4G) Academy (segmentation-driven training delivery), the consolidated communication/action queue, the supplier-voice feedback loop, and the AI-powered "Supplier Advisor."
- Partner with GPT, the Ada and Quick Suite teams, and Amazon Learn to design and deliver integrations (e.g., Supplier Connect, Supplier 360, EcoVadis/Avetta, Contract Central), defining build/buy decisions, phasing, and dependencies.
- Design and govern the cross-pillar content and curriculum model: establish SED as the content-governance authority while sub-pillars contribute pillar-specific modules under a shared standard.
- Define, instrument, and report the metrics that matter: supplier participation and adoption, duplicative-outreach reduction, learning completion correlated to compliance outcomes, badge-tier progression, and the commercial pull-through of certified suppliers into sourcing.
- Build mechanisms — playbooks, SOPs, intake and prioritization frameworks, and self-service pathways— that let the journey scale across categories, regions, and business units without proportional headcount growth.
- Serve as a primary point of contact for supplier-engagement technology questions and development activity across the GPS ecosystem, and drive alignment across procurement, sustainability, learning, legal, and technology partners.


A day in the life
Your morning might start by reviewing adoption and participation metrics from the supplier portal and triaging where suppliers are getting stuck in the journey. Mid-morning, you are in a working session with the GPT and Ada teams, pressure-testing the design of the Supplier Advisor agent and the S4G Badge dashboard against real supplier scenarios. After lunch, you are aligning three GPS sub-pillars on a single, deduplicated communication queue so suppliers stop receiving conflicting requests. Later, you are writing the requirements that connect training completion to certification scoring, and preparing a business review that connects those technology investments to supplier outcomes and GPS goals. No two days look alike, but the through-line is constant: making Amazon's sustainability expectations clear, accessible, and worth achieving for every supplier — through technology that scales.

About the team
We sit at the intersection of procurement and sustainability, focused on one mission: partnering with suppliers to make life better every day. We consolidate supplier engagement and development across Community Impact, Social Responsibility, Environment, and Supplier Development & Impact into one coordinated function, so suppliers experience a single, coherent Amazon rather than four uncoordinated ones. We make it easier for suppliers of every size — small, medium, and large; local and global — to understand what Amazon expects, to build the capabilities to meet it, and to be recognized when they do. We are collaborative, data-driven, and builder-minded: we partner across procurement, sustainability, learning, and technology to turn independent activities into a scalable, accountable system. If you want work that combines strategic thinking, technology, and tangible impact on real businesses and communities, this is the team.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of program or project management experience
- 1+ years of supply chain experience
- Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document, or experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Experience owning program strategy, managing end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Experience in procurement, negotiation, sales, consulting, supply chain, product/project management, or marketing
- Experience practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, or equivalent)
- Experience running metrics reports, analyzing data to identify problems and using data analysis to generate and explain metrics
- Experience building strategic relationships with stakeholders, including communicating and collaborating across teams and functions
- Experience producing executive-level written materials and presenting to executive audiences
- Experience leading process improvement, systems development, and project management

title: Software Engineer, Worldwide Amazon Stores Finance Technology, Controllership Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's finance teams rely on financial controls to keep spending accurate and financial reports audit-ready. You will build the systems that automate those controls, catch errors and waste before money is spent, and give finance analysts fast, trusted answers through AI tools built on cloud services and large-scale data.

Key job responsibilities
- Build services that check purchase requests and orders against finance rules in near real time, then correct or flag issues before approval.
- Automate financial controls, such as reviews of fixed assets, leases, cost centers, open orders, so finance teams spend less time collecting data by hand and more time acting on exceptions.
- Build data pipelines on AWS, including Lambda, StepFunctions, Glue, EMR, DDB, and S3, that feed C-Hub/dashboards finance teams use during month-end close and audit reviews.
- Build AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with the Strands SDK, including MCP tools, context and memory management, evaluation, harnesses, and guardrails that keep finance answers accurate.
- Big data experience with Spark, StarRocks, or similar OLAP engines.
- Build web applications and browser extensions in React and TypeScript that let finance users review exceptions, filter large datasets, and export results.
- Turn defined business requirements into technical designs, review them with senior engineers, and take them from prototype to production.
- Own your services in production. Write the tests, alarms, and automated rollbacks that let a change reach customers in hours, not days. Take part in on-call rotation.
- Work directly with finance, accounting, product, and data science partners, and explain technical tradeoffs.

A day in the life
Most of your day goes to building. You might start by looking into an alarm from an overnight data job that feeds a finance control. Then you meet an accounting partner to design how a manual review could run automatically. After lunch, you write code and tests and ship the change through an automated pipeline the same day. Some weeks, you test a new AI model against an evaluation set to see if it gives better answers. Near month-end close, you answer finance users who want to know why a control flagged a transaction.

About the team
We are a team of software engineers who build the tools that keep Amazon's spending accurate and its financial reports audit-ready. Our customers are finance analysts, accountants, and employees across Amazon who buy goods and services. We own our products end to end, from data pipelines and services to the web apps and AI agents people use every day. We ship changes through automated pipelines and measure our work by the manual effort and errors we remove. We value clear writing, careful reviews, and engineers who ask why a process exists before they automate it.

title: Sr Pre-Construction Manager, GES NA, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Preconstruction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design & Construction (D&C), you are Amazon's senior owner's representative during the preconstruction phase — responsible for autonomously managing complex, cross-functional industrial building projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution across your assigned region. Preconstruction services refers to the planning of a construction project before actual construction begins.

You will partner with internal and external stakeholders to ensure scope, budget, and schedule definition are established, including timely receipt of building and site permits. You are responsible as the senior project manager to lead planning, design, and preconstruction projects — including new built-to-suit industrial buildings, tenant improvements, extensions of existing facilities, and renovation projects — serving major business customers within your region.

You execute deliverables with limited oversight, using advanced professional concepts to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways. You deliver a mix of tactical and strategic initiatives (60% tactical / 40% strategic) that impact multiple teams and/or geographies in support of significant business objectives. You own project budgets, oversee design management, select external vendor partners, and lead project procurement — and you are accountable for the full performance of your external project teams. You show excellent judgment when driving project escalations and make difficult trade-off decisions between short-term and long-term needs, defending those decisions to internal stakeholders.

Beyond project delivery, you guide preconstruction managers in best practices in stakeholder management and project delivery, contribute to developing Amazon's internal and external construction networks, and are learning to force multiply — elevating the performance of the teams and partners around you. You write effective narratives and present complex decisions and trade-offs to Directors and VPs. You actively recruit, mentor, and develop other preconstruction managers.

This role requires 60% regional travel on a yearly basis. When not traveling, you must have availability to work from a corporate office. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the corporate office locations listed. Relocation assistance may be provided.

Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance
- Own and enforce Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams during the planning and preconstruction phases; set the standard for safety culture on complex projects
- Lead coordination with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) to ensure regulatory compliance, smooth permitting execution, and timely approvals
- Review noise, traffic, and environmental studies; understand and apply zoning, planning, fire code, and building code requirements for assigned projects
- Proactively identify and eliminate compliance risks before they become project roadblocks

Preconstruction & Project Management
- Autonomously manage complex, cross-functional industrial preconstruction projects from site selection through design completion, permitting, and contract execution; contribute to significantly complex projects as part of a team
- Lead site selection and validation, scope development, and design management — overseeing design teams in developing site plans and composite floor plans in compliance with Amazon's design standards and operational requirements
- Oversee design management end-to-end, including design evaluations, design conformance reviews, and value engineering assessments
- Manage multiple concurrent large industrial projects across various locations simultaneously, leading a region or program with limited management oversight
- Keep scope under control and accelerate progress by driving crisp, timely decisions, identifying and clearing blockers, and managing escalations with excellent judgment
- Identify and resolve upstream issues proactively to support a clean handoff to the Construction Manager; remain a key support resource and authority on project issues for the construction team throughout the project lifecycle
- Monitor project performance metrics, anticipate roadblocks and risks, manage escalations, and ensure corrective actions are taken
- Resolve complex issues and find a path forward in difficult situations; make and defend trade-off decisions between short-term and long-term needs
- Assess project performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability; deliver solutions that meet standards for customer satisfaction, efficiency, stability, and operational excellence
- Maintain a broad perspective — understand how project components drive successful programs, business portfolios, and not just individual projects

Budget, Schedule & Contract Management
- Own project budgets and oversee spend approvals across all assigned preconstruction projects
- Perform conceptual estimating and pricing reviews for scope inclusions and exclusions; lead negotiations on the cost of work with developers, general contractors, and design consultants
- Lead external partner selection, contract negotiations, and project procurement functions; ensure contracts are fit for purpose, cost-effective, and incorporate appropriate service level agreements
- Review and analyze design and construction contracts, related exhibits, and lease agreements; provide detailed analysis and approvals of technical matters and site-specific deal structures and terms
- Review additional reports including noise and traffic studies and environmental assessments
- Partner with the Transaction team and developers to optimize schedule and strategy for entitlements and long-lead procurement
- Identify and solve factors that may impede a successful permitted project handover to Amazon stakeholders; make trade-offs between short-term and long-term needs

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
- Work with internal and external teams — including Real Estate, Design Engineering, Entitlements, Construction, Finance, Launch/Startup, architects, engineers, permitting agencies, developers, and landlords — to secure resources, scope infrastructure builds, set priorities and milestones, and drive delivery to meet deadlines
- Drive results through communicating, weighing risks, making decisions, leading, and influencing; serve as an authority on project issues across diverse audiences
- Select external vendor partners and manage delivery from external service partners to drive delivery with efficient use of resources and technology
- Lead large cross-functional teams to complete preconstruction projects; skillfully motivate and focus people of all levels to deliver complex projects
- Drive significant communication across departments, from front-line to executive-level managers; achieve high-level alignment and consensus with internal and external stakeholders across diverse teams (legal, regulatory, operations, engineering, finance, external industry groups)
- Act as the primary escalation point for project team members; own and track issues to ensure they are addressed, documented, and resolved
- Support crucial relationships and lead negotiations of agreements with customers, suppliers, and external partners
- Contribute to developing Amazon's internal and external construction networks

Communication & Reporting
- Write effective narratives and present complex decisions, trade-offs, and potential solutions to Directors and VPs
- Translate technical documents and information into end-to-end stories providing detailed risk analysis for leaders and customers
- Communicate budgets, schedules, project status, and priorities clearly to internal teams and external partners
- Run preconstruction meetings effectively — putting the right people in the room, driving detailed discussions, and achieving high-level alignment and consensus
- Utilize Amazon's information systems to record and update schedule, budget, and other key project developments
- Represent Amazon's interests in weekly Architect, Owner, and Contractor (AOC) meetings; provide input on root causes and corrective actions

Process Improvement, Best Practices & People Development
- Drive continuous improvement and create sustainable, repeatable processes and playbooks for the team and region
- Contribute to process improvement ideas; develop tools and procedures that improve project efficiency and delivery across the organization
- Drive efficiencies, streamline workflows, and mitigate excess process and risk
- Learn to force multiply — drive adoption of best practices and elevate the performance of teams and partners
- Recommend improvements to the way projects are scoped, permitted, and executed across the region or organization
- Guide preconstruction managers in best practices in stakeholder management and project delivery; frequently serve as an expert resource on complicated technical, jurisdictional, or regulatory issues
- Actively recruit, mentor, and develop other preconstruction managers within your organization and location
- Assist leadership in building internal and external talent networks
- Participate in the interview process and help train new team members
- Support Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion as fundamentally right for all employees by fostering a culture where inclusion is the norm
- Insist on the highest standards from self and others; drive accountability for results

A day in the life
Each day, you represent GES NA Design & Construction as Amazon's senior owner during the preconstruction phase — executing autonomously, leading with no authority, and influencing the best project decisions across your region. You are 60% tactical and 40% strategic, planning your projects with limited management oversight and frequently called upon as an expert resource. Your day may include:
- Leading design reviews and providing strategic direction to architects, engineers, and design consultants on complex projects
- Negotiating contract terms with developers, general contractors, and consultants while driving adherence to schedules and budgets
- Presenting project status, risks, and trade-off decisions to senior leadership (Directors and VPs)
- Coordinating with AHJ on permitting status, zoning, fire code, and building code requirements
- Monitoring project performance metrics and driving corrective actions with external partners
- Partnering with Real Estate and Transaction teams on entitlement strategy and long-lead procurement
- Mentoring PCMs and contributing to team development and best practices
- Developing or updating process playbooks based on lessons learned from current projects
- Leveraging project management principles and analytics to identify, avoid, or correct issues before they become roadblocks

About the team
At Amazon, the GES North America Design & Construction team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. We are employee owners who take pride in delivering high-quality, innovative facilities — on time and on budget — for our internal customers and the communities we serve. We are committed to being Earth's best employer and to building a more sustainable future through every project we deliver.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of project management, real estate development, architecture/design experience
- Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
- 7+ years of experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's Project Management Representative, or in a related commercial development or construction discipline
- 7+ years of project management experience from design phase through implementation and operation, including negotiating construction, procurement, and labor contracts
- Experience within packaging, processing, or logistical facilities with complex equipment, or comparable experience
- Position includes travel up to 60% (Nationwide). Travel involves air travel to regional airports and driving to site locations. A valid driver's license is required due to project assignments in areas with limited public transportation and rideshare options.

Preferred qualifications

- Advanced degree or certification in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or Business Administration
- Experience operating across at least two disciplines within the construction industry (e.g., General Contracting, Owner's Representation, Commercial Development, Engineering & Design, or Owner's Project Management)
- Demonstrated capability in planning, design review, implementation, and project management/control of new structures and enhancement of existing facilities
- Experience managing multi-disciplinary design incorporating industrial automation, robotics, or similar
- Strong influencing and negotiating skills; demonstrated ability to lead with no authority and build consensus across diverse stakeholder groups
- Demonstrated success communicating complex decisions and trade-offs to senior leadership (Director/VP level)
- Experience developing and implementing preconstruction processes, playbooks, or best practice frameworks
- Experience mentoring and developing junior preconstruction professionals
- Knowledge of Building Information Modeling (BIM)
- CMIT/CMAA or PMP certification or equivalent

title: HW Commodity Procurement Specialist II, Amazon Leo Government
descriptionHtml:
This HW Commodity Procurement Specialist II will be the driving force behind sourcing excellence and supplier compliance for hardware procurement programs, transforming complex engineering requirements into qualified, reliable, and cost-effective supply chain solutions with the speed and precision needed to meet aggressive program timelines. As the critical link between engineering design teams and the supplier base, this role ensures that every sourced component meets rigorous quality, traceability, and compliance standards while building a resilient and scalable supplier network that supports long-term program success.

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated HW Commodity Procurement Specialist II to lead upstream sourcing activities, supplier qualification, and compliance management for hardware procurement programs. This role sits at the critical intersection of engineering requirements, supplier management, and procurement execution, ensuring that sourcing strategies deliver qualified components on time, within budget, and in full compliance with applicable quality and traceability standards.
In this role, you will serve as the primary sourcing point of contact between engineering teams, commodity managers, and the external supplier base, translating hardware design specifications, bill-of-materials requirements, and component-level needs into executable sourcing strategies. You will be responsible for identifying, evaluating, and qualifying new suppliers, managing approved vendor lists (AVLs), conducting supplier capability assessments, and ensuring that all sourcing decisions support program milestones, cost targets, and supply chain resilience objectives.
The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, possesses strong knowledge of electronic, mechanical, and RF hardware commodities, and has a proven ability to build productive supplier relationships while maintaining rigorous compliance and quality standards. You will own the upstream procurement lifecycle from requirements analysis through supplier qualification, source selection, and procurement readiness.


Key job responsibilities
Sourcing Strategy and Supplier Identification
· Analyze engineering design specifications, bills of materials, and component requirements to develop sourcing strategies that balance cost, quality, lead time, and supply chain resilience
· Conduct market research and supplier landscape assessments to identify potential sources for electronic, mechanical, RF, and specialty hardware components
· Evaluate make-vs-buy decisions in partnership with engineering and commodity management teams
· Develop and maintain commodity sourcing roadmaps aligned with program milestones and product lifecycle requirements
· Identify long-lead-time components, sole-source risks, and Diminishing Manufacturing Sources and Material Shortages (DMSMS) concerns, and develop proactive mitigation strategies

Security Clearance: This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and candidates must be able to obtain and maintain a US Government security clearance of TS/SCI.


A day in the life
Supplier Qualification and Onboarding
· Lead the end-to-end supplier qualification process including capability assessments, quality system evaluations, financial health reviews, and on-site audits
· Manage the onboarding of new suppliers into procurement systems, ensuring all required certifications, representations, and compliance documentation are collected and validated
· Coordinate with engineering teams to conduct first article inspections (FAIs), sample evaluations, and component qualification testing for new sources
· Maintain and manage approved vendor lists (AVLs), ensuring supplier status is current and aligned with program requirements
· Conduct Third Party Supplier Assessments (TPSAs) by coordinating required inputs from engineers and sourcing leads
Compliance and Documentation Management
· Ensure all sourcing decisions and supplier selections comply with applicable quality, traceability, and anti-counterfeiting standards
· Verify supplier certifications, quality management system credentials (e.g., AS9100, ISO 9001), and industry-specific compliance documentation
· Maintain auditable procurement records including supplier qualification files, source selection documentation, and compliance verification records
· Coordinate with compliance and contracts teams to ensure proper flow-down of applicable requirements to suppliers and subcontractors
· Monitor supplier compliance status and drive corrective actions when deficiencies are identified
Supplier Relationship and Performance Management
· Build and maintain productive relationships with key suppliers to ensure alignment on quality expectations, delivery commitments, and continuous improvement objectives
· Track and report on supplier performance metrics including on-time delivery, quality defect rates, responsiveness, and corrective action closure rates
· Conduct regular supplier business reviews and scorecards to drive accountability and performance improvement
· Manage supplier escalations related to quality, capacity, or delivery concerns, coordinating cross-functional resolution with engineering and commodity management teams
· Identify opportunities for supplier consolidation, dual-sourcing, and strategic partnerships to improve cost competitiveness and supply chain resilience
Cross-Functional Coordination and Reporting
· Coordinate daily with HW Commodity Specialists, engineering teams, and program managers to align sourcing activities with program schedules and engineering milestones
· Provide regular sourcing status updates to leadership through written narratives, dashboards, and review meetings
· Participate in procurement readiness reviews, design reviews, and program milestone assessments to ensure sourcing readiness
· Collaborate with inventory management and order execution teams to ensure smooth handoff from sourcing qualification to purchase order placement
· Contribute to continuous improvement of sourcing processes, tools, templates, and standard operating procedures

- 5+ years of relevant strategic sourcing including vendor negotiations, global contract management, process improvement, operational and financial analysis experience
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, or a related technical field
- Experience in procurement, supply chain, inventory management, contract management, lease administration or operations

title: Senior Process Engineer, NA SSD Network, Sub Same Day Process Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is building the next generation software, hardware, and processes that will run the global network of fulfillment centers that move many millions of units of inventory, and ensure that customers get what they want faster than ever. We do this by building automated solutions to handle things that technology does well, while relying on people to handle things that humans do well.

We are constantly innovating in the ways we are automating and accelerating the delivery of products and packages which includes building custom hardware and applying robotics, autonomy, supply chain optimization, machine learning, manipulation, image processing, and real-time data processing using distributed systems.

Sub Same Day (SSD) Engineering is looking for a Senior Process Engineer with a strong delivery record and proven project management experience to own strategic and tactical, cross-functional operations and technology projects associated with (SSD) facilities.

As a Senior Process Engineer for Amazon, you will work with some of the most talented engineers in the design, development, and delivery of physical distribution systems around the globe.

You will lead initiatives and complex cross-functional projects or programs that focus on the building of new, the alteration of existing, and the closing of end-of-life material handling and technology systems. As a working leader, you are able to take the lead on the implementation and delivery of large system designs and advanced technology in ambiguous and complex problem spaces.

You integrate systems for safety, security, stability, and efficiency. You participate in the full system development life cycle, working within broadly defined parameters, including test plan execution and solution quality needs.

You must be responsive, flexible, and able to succeed within an open collaborative environment. Amazon’s culture encourages innovation and expects engineers to take a high-level of ownership in solving complex problems.

If you are a leader with enhanced focus on Quality, strong problem-solving skills, excellent communication skills, an ability to influence business and technical leaders in a dynamic environment with the desire to contribute to Amazon's next generation fulfillment technology, this opportunity is for you.

Joining our team provides the unique challenge and opportunity to deploy systems that benefit millions of customers.

The ideal candidate will draw upon exemplary leadership skills, program and project management, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.

The candidate should be open to new tasks, innovative, creative, self-directed and a great team player. Candidate should drive continuous process improvement, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional operational and development teams to solve problems and implement new solutions.

Your experience in conducting root cause analysis, will help in implementation of long-term solutions. You will be traveling (50%) to sites to ensure practical outcomes match theoretical ones.

descriptionHtml:
Job description
AWS is looking for a Network Deploy Technician to join our growing team within infrastructure operations. You will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network.

The position's responsibilities include scaling support of several data center locations and day to day assistance with capacity management. You will work closely with internal customers and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Network Leadership and Technical Project Managers.

You will leverage your experience supporting large scale, enterprise class networks as well as network implementation and troubleshooting. As a Network Deploy Technician, you will work in a fast paced, collaborative environment with regular peer and customer interaction. In addition to providing management and support of AWS’ vast network infrastructure, Network Deploy Technicians establish and follow best practices and refine operational procedures.

All physical requirements are expected with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
• Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
• Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
• Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
• Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities
• Managing work and priorities through ticketing system and workflows to complete customer requests and projects
• Collaborating with various stakeholders to remove project obstacles
• Troubleshooting networking, routing and interconnectivity issues, including patch panels and patch cords
• Specifying Power and Cooling requirements and ensuring Hardware Racking/Stacking completed for new equipment
• Participating in the migration, basic configuration and rollout of new or upgraded hardware

Traveling within and outside of regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

A day in the life
Our team has three primary tasks:
1. Providing the first level networking devices to serve our customer racks entails various tasks (the name of the game is efficiency): You will track network rack intake and delivery; work with various onsite teams to request for rack space, power, and cooling for network racks. And then partner with network engineers to ensure all configurations are ready. You'll also be working on link and device troubleshooting within a certain Service-Level Agreement
2. There is also console builds (and room builds) that are really exciting. You'll be exposed to more teams whose goal is to provide more space and capacity for customer racks.
3. Work with ID-Scaling peers to build higher-level networking devices.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience
- 1+ years of computer networking experience
- High school or equivalent diploma

Preferred qualifications

- Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure

You will work with physical security, construction security specialists, and our Government counterparts to take classified space from design to accredited and keep it that way. If you like owning the details that unlock everything else, this role is for you.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and maintain the ICD 705 Fixed Facility Checklist and accreditation package.
- Coordinate with the Government AO and CTTA on construction security and TEMPEST requirements.
- Track accreditation status, findings, and reaccreditation actions.
- Support construction surveillance and physical-security documentation.
- Collaborate with internal teams, general contractors, architects and engineers prior to and during facility builds to ensure government build compliance.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Sr. Product Compliance Associate, Portugese, Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
This is a contractual position for a 6-month duration.

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform.
Founded by Jeff Bezos, the Amazon.com website started in 1995 as a place to buy books because of the unique customer experience the Web could offer book lovers. Bezos believed that only the Internet could offer customers the convenience of browsing a selection of millions of book titles in a single sitting. During the first 30 days of business, Amazon fulfilled orders for customers in 50 states and 45 countries - all shipped from his Seattle-area garage.
Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Compliance Associate, your responsibility is reviewing the latest product information as per Standard Operations Procedures (SOP) and cross-checking it against the relevant regulatory documentation. Using various Amazon-specific tools and systems you classify the products to ensure they meet the necessary compliance requirements for availability on Amazon. Throughout the day, you work closely with your manager and the Process Experts and address any deviations from standard SOPs, seeking their guidance when necessary. You maintain detailed records of your assigned tasks and utilize standardized reports to prioritize your work, ensuring you meet Quality, Productivity and Service Level Agreement targets. You may identify opportunities for improvement and collaborate with partner teams to explore ways to reduce manual effort, such as automating reports using Excel queries. You share feedback on the team's SOPs, contributing to the ongoing refinement of the operational processes. You participate in knowledge-sharing sessions, contributing with your expertise and learnings. As a mentor, you may support peers by answering their queries and providing process-level training.

Required Skills:
• Ability to use Microsoft Excel tool as per role requirements (filtering and sorting in data sets, cell referencing, pivot tables, data validation, etc.)
• Basic understanding of SQL, can self-service defined queries and make simple changes to retrieve data from a database
• Knowledgeable in Customer Relationship Management tools, managing customer data and tracking interactions
• Attention to detail and ability to analyze and identify patterns across data sets and information
• Problem-solving skills, with the ability to find solutions through logic, intuition, creativity, and design thinking
• Commitment to investigation, research, and diving deep to seek facts
• Ability to understand, interpret, critique, analyses and communicate data



About the team
The Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) organization is a component of Amazon's operations, dedicated to ensuring the compliance of its products and services worldwide. GSRC's core mission is to keep customers, partners, and associates safe while protecting the company from legal and regulatory risks. With a diverse global team spanning across India, China, Poland, Romania, Netherlands, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica, GSRC partners with its stakeholders to classify products and ensure regulatory and legal compliance for product listings. GSRC raises the bar on quality by implementing operational changes matching the everchanging regulatory space. The team designs global, consistent, and scalable solutions and prioritize a blend between technology-driven and human decision-making processes. GSRC believes that innovation thrives on diversity, fostering an inclusive and equitable culture that empowers employees with opportunities for learning and development.

title: Data Center Cluster Operations Leader, AMER North East DC Ops
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) Infrastructure Operations is growing rapidly, with new data center facilities coming online to support expanding machine learning and core cloud computing workloads. We are looking for a Cluster Operations Leader to help us keep pace with that growth by leading the teams responsible for the safety, security, availability, scaling, efficiency, and cost management of Amazon data center clusters and colocation operations within an assigned region.

Infrastructure Operations consists of two core functions: Data Center Operations (DCO) and Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO). DCO manages server-level platforms supporting Amazon Retail and AWS, while DCEO handles mechanical, electrical, and controls systems for critical environments. A physical security team also works closely with these functions to protect people, assets, and customer data. As Cluster Operations Leader, you will build and lead high-performing teams across both functions, combining strategic oversight with hands-on technical problem-solving to deliver reliable, efficient infrastructure at scale. You will also explore the analytical use of AI agents to increase operational productivity and accelerate capacity delivery for business priorities. This role gives you direct exposure to the latest data center infrastructure and cloud technologies while you manage large-scale operations teams — a combination that positions you for continued growth within AWS.

Key job responsibilities
- Build, hire, and develop operations managers and their teams across compute and engineering operations, ensuring the right talent and team structure to support facility growth
- Design and execute the operational strategy for new data center and colocation expansions, including preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, and change management programs
- Lead incident response for safety, security, and availability events, driving root-cause analysis and long-term corrective actions
- Identify and implement process improvements, including the analytical use of AI agents, to increase operational productivity and reduce costs
- Partner with engineering, supply chain, and capacity planning teams to align infrastructure delivery with machine learning and core cloud computing demand

A day in the life
You will split your time between strategic planning sessions with your peer managers in engineering and capacity planning, and operational reviews with your direct reports who run day-to-day compute and engineering operations. Mornings may involve reviewing incident reports and maintenance metrics with your DCEO and DCO leads, while afternoons shift to working with cross-regional partners on expansion timelines or evaluating AI-driven productivity tools with your team. When an availability event occurs, you step in to coordinate the response and ensure rapid resolution.

About the team
Our Infrastructure Operations team keeps AWS running by owning the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment inside every AWS data center. We are in a period of significant facility growth driven by increasing demand for machine learning and core cloud computing capacity, and this role is central to making sure that growth translates into reliable, efficient operations for our customers. We are a collaborative group of engineers, operations managers, and technical specialists who take pride in solving hard problems together and continuously raising the bar on operational performance. You will gain hands-on experience with emerging infrastructure and cloud technologies as the team scales, building expertise that grows alongside the business.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, engineering or a related technical field
- 10+ years of relevant management experience in Data Centers operations, facility engineering operations, information technology critical environment facilities, advanced high-volume manufacturing, datacenter buildouts and scaling, or similar experience
- Experience in management of datacenter operations, facility engineering operations, information technology critical environment facilities, advanced high volume manufacturing, datacenter build-outs and scaling, or similar fields
- Demonstrated track record in delivering complex analytical and quantitative projects through verbal and written communication.
- Proven ability to hire, develop and manage high-performing geographically distributed technical teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Continuous Improvement and Six Sigma methodologies
- Knowledge of information technology infrastructure domains such as compute server platforms, storage server platforms, server components, network devices, technologies and architectures, IT service delivery principles and best practices
- Knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and controls systems for critical infrastructures

title: Controls Technician, Controls Deployment Service
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

Key job responsibilities
Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.

Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.

Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.

Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.

Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.

Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.

Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.

Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.

Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.

Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.

Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.

Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.

Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.

Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.

Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.

Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.

Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.

Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.

Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Controls Technician, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who rely on you to keep Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) healthy and operational. On a given day, you are the boots on the ground solving problems that directly impact data center availability. You might diagnose a controller communication loss, calibrate instruments feeding inaccurate data to operators, or supervise vendors performing quarterly maintenance. For new builds, you perform point to point testing and support commissioning alongside construction teams. Your internal stakeholders include your Controls Engineer, Controls Manager, partner teams (Field Engineering, Critical Project Implementation, DCEO), and the vendors you oversee.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Associate's degree
- High school or equivalent diploma
- Associate’s degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field with [Year_1] years of relevant industrial Controls or HVAC controls experience, OR [Year_2] years of relevant industrial or HVAC controls experience in lieu of a degree.
- Basic understanding of Industrial controls system, knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, relays and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment in a data center, hospitals, large commercial complex, water, power, oil & gas or similar industries.
- [Year_3] years of experience working with low voltage controls, wiring, networking signals, electrical and mechanical systems, computers and operating systems.
- Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts and overtime as required.

Preferred qualifications

- Associate’s Degree in related field
- International Society of Automation (ISA) Certified Controls System Technician (CCST) Level I or higher certification.
- Experience using common communication protocols (MQTT, BACnet, and/or MODBUS).
- 5+ years of experience in controls/automation, construction or related field in a technical environment.
- Demonstrated understanding of engineering documentation, electrical and mechanical diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
- Experience in data centers or mission critical environment
- Fundamental knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling.
- Prior AWS/Amazon experience

title: Senior Data Scientist, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to transform complex satellite, network, and customer terminal telemetry into actionable insights that drive system performance, reliability, and engineering decisions.

In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated across satellite payloads, ground infrastructure, customer terminals, and end-to-end laboratory and on-orbit testing environments. You will develop analytical models, statistical methods, and automated data processing solutions to identify performance trends, detect anomalies, isolate issues, and support system validation and operational readiness.

You will partner closely with systems, hardware, software, RF, and test engineering teams to establish meaningful performance metrics, correlate telemetry across multiple system components, and translate complex technical data into clear recommendations. Your work will directly influence engineering priorities, test strategies, system improvements, and launch readiness decisions.

The ideal candidate combines strong statistical and data science expertise with practical experience analyzing complex engineering systems, processing high-volume time-series data, and developing scalable analytical solutions. Experience in satellite communications, wireless networks, or telecommunications is highly desirable.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and maintain scalable data processing and analytical solutions for satellite payload, ground network, customer terminal, and laboratory test telemetry.
- Analyze large volumes of structured and unstructured data to identify system performance trends, anomalies, degradation, and potential failure conditions.
- Correlate telemetry across satellite payloads, RF systems, networking infrastructure, customer terminals, and application-level measurements to identify relationships and isolate root causes.
- Design statistical models, machine learning techniques, and predictive analytics to detect anomalies, characterize system behavior, and identify emerging reliability or performance issues.
- Establish performance baselines, key performance indicators (KPIs), and statistical methodologies to evaluate system functionality, reliability, and performance across laboratory and on-orbit environments.

And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will provide full life-cycle support to AWS Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. You will be the ‘go to’ engineering resource for your region when technical advice is needed, and will use your subject matter expertise and engage with diverse teams to:

* Develop innovative solutions for AWS’s data centers.

* Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.

* Initiate and lead engineering audits including on-site visits within Amazon’s data centers. Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediation.

* Act as resident engineer during new construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and turnover

Key job responsibilities
Amazon's vision is to be the world's most customer-centric company, and this role is key to that vision. As an Amazon Critical Infrastructure Engineer, you will be leading projects to fit out our data centers to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale. As an ideal candidate you:

* Possess Strong Engineering Judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty/ambiguity.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

descriptionHtml:
Esta é uma posição de tempo integral, permanente, presencial baseada em REC3-(Cabo de Santo Agost,BR) e não oferece benefícios de realocação. Os candidatos devem estar localizados e legalmente autorizados a trabalhar no Brasil para serem elegíveis para consideração.
A equipe de Engenharia de Manutenção e Confiabilidade (Reliability Maintenance Engineering - RME) na Amazon é fundamental para nossas operações - são eles que mantêm maquinários vitais funcionando o tempo todo. Como Técnico de RME, você fará a manutenção de uma ampla gama de equipamentos e espaços de trabalho, ao mesmo tempo em que mantém as melhores práticas de Saúde e Segurança. Você ajudará a manter seus colegas seguros e prevenir o tempo de inatividade das máquinas. Nossos Técnicos de RME aumentam a disponibilidade e qualidade de nossos equipamentos e também trabalham para melhorar o ambiente operacional.

Key job responsibilities
- Tarefas de manutenção proativa e preventiva em uma ampla gama de equipamentos do site.
- Realizar reparos reativos e diagnóstico de falhas em um centro de distribuição em operação.
- Utilizar as ferramentas mais recentes para maximizar a eficácia dos equipamentos.
- Manter todas as políticas e práticas de saúde e segurança.
- Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a progressão de aprendizes no local.
- Trabalhar em projetos de melhoria contínua e implementar as melhores práticas em diversos sites do Brasil.


A day in the life
Nossos Técnicos de RME estão baseados no site, para que possam responder rapidamente a quaisquer problemas com maquinários. Você realizará uma série de manutenções preventivas planejadas nos equipamentos de nossos sites para garantir que estejam funcionando com segurança. Como Técnico de RME, você também responderá prontamente a avarias, investigando, encontrando e implementando soluções o mais rápido possível. Você também fará sugestões para melhorias de longo prazo.

Trabalhando ao lado de colegas mais experientes, você realizará tarefas de manutenção diárias e fará a ligação com contratados se precisar de expertise externa. Você poderá trabalhar em uma variedade de turnos (dia ou noite) para garantir que nossos sites sejam apoiados 24 horas por dia - permitindo que a Amazon entregue na velocidade pela qual somos conhecidos.

About the team
Nossa equipe de Engenharia de Manutenção e Confiabilidade ou RME mantém nossos equipamentos funcionando em seu melhor desempenho. Somos uma equipe com mentalidade técnica, composta por excelentes jogadores de equipe e guiada por líderes experientes. Trabalhamos juntos para manter, solucionar problemas e reparar equipamentos em nossa rede global de centros de distribuição. Algumas de nossas pessoas são líderes, que supervisionam a equipe enquanto trabalham com tecnologia empolgante - algumas das quais existem apenas na Amazon.

Desde a instalação de sistemas automatizados de embalagem até a supervisão da manutenção geral de um site e o reparo de equipamentos-chave de distribuição, nossa equipe lida com a maioria dos aspectos técnicos da Amazon. title: Sr. Supply Chain Security Assessor, Supply Chain and Intellectual Property Security
descriptionHtml:
We're seeking a Security Supply Chain Assessor to help protect Amazon's global supply chain through comprehensive security assessments and risk management. This role requires international travel (up to 75%) across the APAC Regions.
The Supply Chain Security Assessor plays a critical role in evaluating and strengthening the security posture of third-party manufacturing and supplier partners across the global supply chain. This position involves conducting on-site Physical and cybersecurity assessments of supplier facilities, verifying adherence to corporate and industry security standards, and identifying risks related to data protection, software provisioning, and hardware production environments.
The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in cybersecurity controls, understanding of physical security controls, a strong understanding of manufacturing and supplier ecosystems, and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally with internal and external stakeholders across multiple time zones and regions.


Key job responsibilities
• Conduct on-site physical and cybersecurity assessments of suppliers and contract manufacturers across APAC.
• Evaluate supplier environments against company and industry security standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST 800-171, TAPA, and internal security frameworks).
• Assess security domains including but not limited to:
o Network segmentation and access control
o Data encryption and protection mechanisms
o Endpoint and server security
o Secure software provisioning and storage
o Incident response and monitoring practices
o CCTV Coverage and Monitoring
o Physical and environmental security controls
• Document findings, develop risk ratings, and provide actionable remediation guidance to suppliers.
• Partner with internal security, compliance, and supply chain teams to ensure continuous improvement of supplier risk management programs.
• Track, monitor, and verify closure of remediation actions through follow-up assessments or evidence reviews.
• Contribute to the development and enhancement of standardized assessment frameworks, methodologies, and automation tools.
• Provide training and knowledge-sharing sessions for suppliers and internal stakeholders to improve overall security maturity.
• Maintain awareness of evolving global cybersecurity regulations, threats, and best practices relevant to the manufacturing and supply chain ecosystem.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Security, Computer Science, Risk Management, Engineering, Math, Statistics, or a related discipline, or equivalent technology experience
- Bachelor's degree or above in Cybersecurity, Information Security, or a related field, or experience in one or more of the following domains: access- control system and methodology, network security, application- and system-development security, security architecture and models, cryptography, and operations security
- 5+ years of any combination of the following: application security frameworks, identity and access controls, incident response, mobile security, cloud computing and security, AI security, threat intelligence, and penetration testing experience
- Experience communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences
- Experience demonstrating strong analytical abilities and confidence in the use of data
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Mandarin
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Experience performing on-site assessments or audits in manufacturing, hardware, or software supply chain environments.
- Strong knowledge of security frameworks (ISO 27001, or similar).

Preferred qualifications

- CISSP, CISA, CISM or other security certification
- Experience working with equipment suppliers, laboratories and manufacturing plants
- Knowledge of security technology and concepts (Authentication, Authorization, Single sign-on, Cryptography, etc.)
- Experience with technology risk, IT security audit, compliance and/or relevant regulatory knowledge

title: Senior Engineer, SoC HAL
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs builds the custom silicon at the heart of AWS machine learning servers, and we are hiring a senior engineer to own the architecture of the Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) that brings these chips to life. If you love working where hardware meets software, writing the code that boots, configures, and debugs some of the largest custom silicon in the world, this is your team.

As a Software Development Engineer III on the SoC HAL team, you will set the software architecture for the driver stack across multiple hardware blocks and chip generations, partner directly with the hardware designers who build the silicon, and raise the engineering bar for a small, fast-moving team inside a large organization. No machine learning background is required (you will pick up ML concepts from colleagues if you want to). This role can be based in Cupertino, CA or Austin, TX.


Key job responsibilities

- Own the design and end-to-end implementation of the HAL/driver software architecture for new chips, including the abstractions, interfaces, and patterns the rest of the team builds against.
- Apply hardware/software co-design principles, partnering early with RTL designers and design verification engineers to shape the manageability and debuggability of the silicon before tape-out.
- Deliver and maintain HAL blocks across the stack (for example PCIe, DDR / HBM memory, DMA, system fabric, interrupt controllers, and boot / firmware), and support prior chips with feature additions and bug fixes.
- Set the standard for how the team tests and continuously deploys the software stack to internal customers, including pre-silicon and hardware-in-the-loop flows.
- Make durable, well-reasoned technical tradeoffs and drive cross-team decisions that span hardware, firmware, and higher-layer system software.
- Mentor and coach other engineers, lead design and code reviews, and act as a technical lead for architecture and engineering best practices.


A day in the life
A typical day moves between writing and reviewing C++ for the HAL, working through a hardware interface question with an RTL or design verification engineer, and shaping the architecture for a block still being designed. You might debug a failure spanning software and silicon, then define the abstractions a new chip will need. Your stakeholders are the hardware design, verification, firmware, and system-software teams; your customers are the internal software teams that rely on the HAL to boot, configure, and debug the chip. Problems range from talking to brand-new hardware to scaling the stack across chip generations.


About the team
Annapurna Labs designs and deploys some of the largest custom silicon in the world, including the Trainium and Inferentia machine learning accelerators. Our SoC HAL team builds the low-level software that boots, configures, and manages these chips, sitting between the hardware and the system software that runs the server. We are a small team that works closely with hardware, holds a high engineering bar, and gives engineers real ownership to shape the architecture they build. Split between Cupertino, CA and Austin, TX with no site preference, we value mentorship, clear written design, and software that outlasts any single chip.
