- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Experience with modern C++ programming including object-oriented design.

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Knowledge of computer architecture, operating systems, and parallel computing
- Experience in hardware/software co-design
- Experience with hardware-in-the-loop testing
- Expertise in one or more of PCIe, HBM or DDR memory, UCIe, DMA engines, chip boot and reset sequences
- Experience defining software architecture across multiple components or teams
- Experience developing device drivers, HAL, or other low-level software that directly interacts with hardware

title: Program Manager Intern, AWS Cloud Logistics
descriptionHtml:
*Internship period: January to June 2027

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS Cloud Logistics (ACL) is looking for a motivated Supply Chain Program Management Intern (Procurement) to join our team in Singapore. In this role, you will drive documentation standardization, process improvement, facilitate sourcing projects, create internal enablement resources and build agentic AI solutions - all within a global supply chain that powers AWS's infrastructure worldwide. You will be able to leverage Amazon's suite of AI tools, Amazon Quick, and its underlying models to optimize your workflow and productivity while continuing to grow and develop your acumen in AI.

Key job responsibilities
- Documentation Standardization & Governance: Lead the standardization of documentation across the team's knowledge base, conducting a comprehensive audit and establishing consistency in format, structure, and content quality. Ensure all customer-facing information is current, accurate, and accessible, implementing a sustainable refresh cadence with clear ownership. Develop a detailed project plan for ongoing documentation maintenance and governance.

- Enablement Flows: Partner with the onboarding and enablement team to design end-to-end flows and playbooks that map the full customer journey within AWS Cloud Logistics. Translate complex, cross-functional processes into clear, repeatable guides that help new joiners and stakeholders ramp quickly and consistently.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Input: Gather input from stakeholders across all levels of the organization to ensure enablement materials reflect how the business actually operates. Build feedback loops and review mechanisms so content stays accurate and sustainable well beyond your tenure.

- Continuous Improvement & Automation: Identify opportunities to simplify and streamline how knowledge is captured, maintained, and surfaced - including exploring AI and automation to reduce manual effort and improve discoverability of enablement resources.

A day in the life
No two days look the same, but every day has a rhythm. Your morning might start by supporting an operational task for the team - pulling data, updating a tracker, or preparing materials for an upcoming review. You then jump into a call with internal stakeholders to align on a project deliverable, followed by a session with an external partner to understand how supply chain processes work on the ground. After lunch you meet with your assigned mentor, who helps you connect the dots between your projects and the bigger picture of AWS's cloud computing infrastructure and global supply chain. The afternoon is heads-down time on one of your dedicated projects - maybe drafting a playbook, building out a knowledge base page, or redesigning an enablement module. Between project sprints, you are meeting with teams across different functions and geographies to learn how our end-to-end supply chain operates and how AWS services underpin it. You also have a regular check-in with your manager to review progress, remove blockers, and discuss your development goals. Most days end knowing you have contributed to something the team will use long after your internship ends - and that you understand a little more about how the cloud gets built.

About the team
AWS Cloud Logistics (ACL) manages a continuously evolving portfolio of shipments through a worldwide supply chain. We deliver the right product at the right time, cost, and place - ensuring our AWS supply chain is reliable. You will work in a fast-paced environment where your contributions will have direct impact on operational efficiency and customer experience. Our team values builders who write things down, simplify complexity, and leave processes better than they found them.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Alexa Connectivity Devices
descriptionHtml:
We are building a new device software team in Bangalore to power the next generation of Amazon connected devices. As an Embedded software Engineer on our new Bangalore device software team, you will bring up new hardware from first power-on, develop firmware for companion microcontrollers, and own the peripheral interfaces that connect our devices to the physical world. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with hardware engineers on schematic reviews and signal integrity, and debug hardware-software interactions at the bench with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.

Key job responsibilities
Lead SoC/MCU board bring-up: power sequencing, clock configuration, peripheral initialization

Develop and maintain firmware for companion MCUs (sensor fusion, audio processing, motor control)

Implement and optimize peripheral drivers: SPI, I²C, UART, GPIO, ADC/DAC, PWM

Collaborate with hardware engineers on schematic review, signal integrity, and design-for-testability

Develop hardware abstraction layers (HAL) for cross-platform portability

Support manufacturing test firmware and production programming flows

Debug hardware-software interaction issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG

A day in the life
As a member of the team, you will serve as the technical leader for device software development and operations. You will collaborate with stakeholders across Alexa Devices and Alexa Cloud teams to define roadmaps, plan requirements, make prioritization trade-offs, and feature development. You will partner with principal engineers to brainstorm solutions, solve problems, and deliver features.


About the team
The Alexa Connected Devices team delivers low-latency, low-cost, highly reliable, and scalable connectivity between Alexa-enabled devices and the Alexa Cloud. We improve the speed and reliability of customer interactions with Alexa while simplifying the developer experience by abstracting connection management. Our services handle tens of billions of transactions daily. This is a highly visible role spanning inception, feature development, and partnering closely with tier-1 Cloud Services. The ideal candidate is passionate about Alexa and thrives delivering high-quality device capabilities in a hyper-growth environment.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- 4+ years of embedded firmware development experience
- Proficiency in C and embedded C++; experience with bare-metal and RTOS-based firmware
- Hands-on experience with ARM Cortex-M and Cortex-A processors
- Strong understanding of peripheral bus protocols: SPI, I²C, UART, CAN
- Ability to read schematics and use lab equipment (oscilloscope, logic analyzer, JTAG debugger)
- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience understanding the basics of software testing or hardware devices like tablets, smartphones, voice recognition devices etc.
- Experience with low-power design techniques (sleep modes, clock gating, voltage scaling)
- Background in audio DSP, sensor fusion, or motor control firmware

职位：日语客服代表
地点：大连


亚马逊的使命是成为地球上最以客户为中心的公司，而我们备受称赞的客户服务团队正是实现这一目标的关键。为我们的客户做到最好是我们的能量来源，我们会不同的方式处理问题，您不会被要求照本宣科或死记硬背。相反，我们将为您提供所有解决客户问题所需的培训。在这里，您有机会在每一次与客户的对话中展示出您的个性，提供出色的客服支持。

作为一名客户服务代表，您将做什么？
作为一名亚马逊客户服务代表，您将需要通过电话、在线聊天和/或电子邮件的形式向客户提供从订单和产品问题到付款事宜和网站指导等一切相关支持以及解决方案。同时，作为客户的第一联系人，您需要及时回复客户投诉问题和客户意见，在系统中准确记录客户的问题及对应情况，并与客户进行有效沟通。

您的工作时间是什么？
为了更好的提供客户服务支持，配合客户的时间，我们的工作时间并不固定。我们根据各种不同的轮班模式来安排工作时间，通常而言，每周出勤5天，休息2天。每天出勤9小时，包含8小时工作时间以及1小时休息时间。在线聊天/邮件业务每天覆盖的班次最早6:00 上班，最晚为23:30 下班。大连电话业务每天覆盖的班次最早6:00 上班，最晚为23:30 下班。您有可能需要在法定节假日工作，并将获得相应的报酬。

Basic qualifications

我们需要您具备的任职资格

  • 具备在中国的工作许可
  • 具有较强的日语沟通能力（包括书面和口头），N1或同等水平
  • 大专及以上学历 (含优秀应届大学毕业生)
  • 有使用电脑工作的经验
  • 能够接受轮班工作和夜班制度
  • 愿意并能够轮流工作（即早班、晚班、通宵、周末，以及根据需要加班）

我们对您的期望
  • 工作勤奋，擅于沟通，注重细节
  • 具备良好的服务意识，以客户为中心
  • 具备良好的学习能力，思维灵活，反应灵敏
  • 在高强度环境中能够自如地处理多项任务
